We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

If you are excited about the prospect of using your cloud architecture experience to assist our most valuable customers, tackling challenging problems, have a hand in shaping the future of cloud adoption, enhancing and growing your own skills, and having fun, then we would love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

You will be a critical partner to our customers, leveraging your experience with large scale cloud transformations and helping shepherd them through their stages of AWS adoption. Guiding the customer through the operational, educational, and governance aspects of a successful AWS cloud journey.

You will interface with customer and AWS leadership, driving collaboration between the other core account groups (Sales, Support, Solutions Architecture, and Professional Services), product/engineering teams, and customer teams, planning and supporting major workload migrations. You will translate strategic initiatives in the account plan into executable actions, working backwards from our customers key milestones. You will manage cadence by leading the reporting and tracking functions along the way. The execution of education plans, roadmap to business outcome alignments, Executive Briefing Sessions, and go-live events and transitions are a few items owned by the CSM that are critical to the success of our customer’s cloud journey.

You are encouraged to think big, invent and take ownership on customer challenges. You will not only bring the best of AWS/Amazon to our customers, you will proactively help solve the customer’s challenges through new ideas, tools and mechanisms.

Successful candidates will have a strong technical background, be aware of details that matter, have excellent problem-solving abilities, and be exemplary communicators both at the executive and project team level. You will be a peer leader, have the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, negotiate and lead virtual teams. Your enterprise cloud experience and operational excellence will influence the team’s decisions, provide insight, and help drive secure and robust solutions.

You will evangelize AWS services and influence customers for adopting them. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by deploying AWS solutions and driving innovation, and also be obsessed with contributing to the day-to-day management of customers’ successful migration to AWS.

Key job responsibilities

Responsibilities

You will establish a deep understanding of your customer’s business vision, culture and processes, and evangelize AWS services and influence customers to adopt the right solution at the right time. Customer Solution Managers (CSM) are responsible for four focus areas:

1/Accelerating AWS Adoption through Delivery and Execution

2/Identify & Align on Strategic Opportunities: CSMs work with the Customer Account team to work backwards from the customer to identify and pursue strategic cloud opportunities. These strategic cloud opportunities can include but are not limited to large-scale migrations, GenAI, data and analytics, digital innovation, high performance computing, product innovation, and business agility.

3/Customer Enablement, you will serve as the customer’s cloud journey coach and be the voice of the customer within AWS, evangelizing customer needs to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams.

4/Implement governance structures to effectively govern both our partnership with the customer, and the customer’s adoption of AWS.

These interconnected focus areas will enable CSMs to effectively drive cloud adoption, pursue strategic growth opportunities, and empower customer success - all of which are critical to achieving the Automotive & Manufacturing IBU’s objectives. By aligning CSM activities, goals, and opportunities under these focus areas, the Automotive & Manufacturing CSM team can ensure a disciplined, customer-centric approach that maximizes business impact and revenue realization for AWS.

CSMs play a critical role supporting account teams/customers throughout the sales process, and the customer's cloud transformation journey, whilst consistently demonstrating measurable value to the customer regardless of engagement model.

CSMs are able to effectively coordinate cross-functional resources, drive disciplined project delivery, and quantify the tangible business benefits that customers realize through their cloud transformation initiatives. This holistic approach to customer engagement, coupled with the CSM's deep understanding of the Automotive & Manufacturing Industry and AWS capabilities; positions CSMs as trusted advisors who can guide customers through every stage of their cloud journey - from initial strategy and planning to migration, modernization, and ongoing optimization.

This position requires 15% - 30% travel across the calendar year to the customer.

Exceptional ability to lead through influence across diverse stakeholder groups

Critical thinking and self-motivation with proven ability to navigate ambiguity

Data-driven decision maker who uses metrics to measure success and drive improvements

Innovative mindset with passion for solving complex customer challenges

Travel 15-30% as needed, primarily for customer facing events.

jobs.title: Life Sciences Practice Leader
jobs.description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

Position: Life Sciences Practice Leader

Ideal Locations: NYC, CHI, ATL and SF (Hub locations)

Location

This is role requires travel to client site and is preferred to be located in a Hub location: NYC, Chicago, Atlanta or San Francisco. If not at client site, 3-4 days in office with some flexibility.

About The Job You're Considering

Capgemini Invent North America is hiring a proven Life Sciences Industry leader to drive transformational change for our clients and their customers.

As a VP and our NA Life Sciences (LS) Industry leader, you will be accountable for shaping and driving the LS industry agenda for Invent North America. We are looking for individuals with experience selling professional consulting services and building CXO relationships within the LS sector. You will be responsible for shaping and executing a forward-looking industry strategy, and positioning Capgemini Invent as a trusted advisor for LS organizations and clients across the North America market.

Your Role (Responsibility)

In this role you will play a key role in:

Setting and executing the industry vision and strategy for Life Sciences in North America, ensuring alignment with both local market needs and global priorities
Driving the growth of the Life Sciences business, with emphasis on exploring how AI can and will influence the future our clients’ businesses Personally leading one or more strategic Life Sciences accounts, developing strong CXO relationships globally, demonstrating account leadership, setting account strategy, collaborating with global capabilities, and leading strategy execution
Maximizing client impact and leading high-value engagements, strategically shape the future of clients across the entire value chain (e.g., personalized health, connected devices, clinical transformation, enterprise transformation, connected health) and with an understanding of AI
Ensuring commercial success through effective management of the industry team, local rollout of key offers and operational excellence
Collaborating with global and local teams, ensuring seamless execution of strategies and contributing to the broader industry network
Expanding and developing the talent within the LS industry team, fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, developing and empowering teams, building capability through recruitment, coaching, and professional development
Being an authority and thought leader within the sector, modelling values and behaviors, and coaching junior team members.

Contributing to internal campaigns, think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development, and offering development

Your Skill and Experiences

At least 10 years of experience in strategy consulting related to digital transformation in the Life Sciences industry.
Hands-on dynamic leader with a strong focus on growth, entrepreneurial thinking, and charismatic role modelling
Strong go-to-market DNA with an established and resilient network of internal and external partnerships at CxO and decision-maker level
Demonstrated success in leading industry growth, client development and team expansion
Proven ability to be successful in a matrixed organization, enlisting support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering consulting solutions
Strong interest in how AI is transforming industries, value chains, and value capture
Strong interest in leveraging AI in your day-to-day activities and encouraging usage and fluency amongst team members
Technical knowledge of end-to-end processes and their implementation in digital business models, customer engagement, intelligent operations, accelerated R&D, business transformation, and sustainability
Ability to work in mixed teams of colleagues and senior executives, developing a collaborative style and fostering a positive, engaging work environment
University degree in a business, technical, medical, or natural sciences field, ideally with a complementary MBA or Doctorate

The base compensation range for this role in the posted location is: $350,000 - $450,000 with additional bonus and equity.

Capgemini provides compensation range information in accordance with applicable national, state, provincial, and local pay transparency laws. The base compensation range listed for this position reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation Capgemini, in good faith, believes it may pay for the role at the time of this posting. This range may be subject to change as permitted by law.

The actual compensation offered to any candidate may fall outside of the posted range and will be determined based on multiple factors legally permitted in the applicable jurisdiction.

These may include, but are not limited to: Geographic location, Education and qualifications, Certifications and licenses, Relevant experience and skills, Seniority and performance, Market and business consideration, Internal pay equity.

It is not typical for candidates to be hired at or near the top of the posted compensation range.

In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for additional compensation such as variable incentives, bonuses, or commissions, depending on the position and applicable laws.

Benefits

Capgemini offers a comprehensive, non-negotiable benefits package to all regular, full-time employees.
In the U.S. and Canada, available benefits are determined by local policy and eligibility and may include:

Paid time off based on employee grade (A-F), defined by policy: Vacation: 12-25 days, depending on grade, Company paid holidays, Personal Days, Sick Leave
Medical, dental, and vision coverage (or provincial healthcare coordination in Canada)
Retirement savings plans (e.g., 401(k) in the U.S., RRSP in Canada)
Life and disability insurance
Employee assistance programs
Other benefits as provided by local policy and eligibility

Compensation (including bonuses, commissions, or other forms of incentive pay) is not considered earned, vested, or payable until it becomes due under the terms of applicable plans or agreements and is subject to Capgemini’s discretion, consistent with applicable laws. jobs.title: Lab Technician
jobs.description:
As a Laboratory Technician working onsite in our production support QC Labs in Delaware, OH, you will be responsible for a variety of laboratory operations in quality assurance and research settings. In the QC team, you will validate raw material and finished good samples, identify result abnormalities, work to mitigate risk of defective material, and aid in the support of our continuous improvement and project initiatives. Laboratory technicians will be agile learners, results driven, and collaborative in their work within the QC team and across multiple functional groups.

The shift for this position is 3rd Shift: 11 pm to 7 am – Sunday night to Friday morning.

Key Responsibilities

Identify and troubleshoot batch QC result abnormalities and take action as able
Test all production samples as required – following SOPs as defined, performing test methods accurately, and recording all test results
Support project and continuous improvement work as needed to help maintain project timelines
Understand customer requirements and determine adjustments for batches as needed
Collaborate with other QC teams, production, and technical groups to independently disposition batches
Maintain all laboratory equipment and perform required calibrations as assigned
Utilize immediate production and project needs to prioritize daily activities
Maintain lab ancillary inventory, daily material stocking needs, and contribute to 6S
Understand, support, and maintain Delaware’s Quality Management System requirements
Support Departmental X matrix action items as assigned
Completion of development plans in entirety
Execution of RCA tasks as assigned

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required
Degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering preferred
1 year of academic or professional laboratory experience and proven ability to accurately apply laboratory methods
Ability to work night shift (3rd shift)
Ability to work weekends as dictated by business need
Ability to work additional overtime as determined by business

Eurofins Scientific is a network of independent companies providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

With over 50 laboratories and more than 40 service centers nationwide, Eurofins Environment Testing provides full-service environmental analysis across all 50 states. Our network supports public and private clients—including DoD, DOE, and municipalities—through robust logistics and continuous investment in people, technology, and infrastructure.

We offer comprehensive testing for air, water, soil, sediment, tissue, and waste, covering a wide range of analytes including PFAS, metals, VOCs/SVOCs, dioxins/furans, radiochemicals, and more.

Job Description

Eurofins Environmental Testing Southwest is seeking a Laboratory Technician to join our team in Tustin, CA. This position is ideal for someone who is dependable, hardworking, detail-oriented, and motivated by the opportunity to contribute to environmental testing and protecting the environment.

Previous laboratory or science experience is not required. We are especially interested in candidates with experience in fast paced, production oriented, or hands on work environments who take pride in doing quality work and following established procedures.

The successful candidate will be trained to perform laboratory sample preparation on water, soil and aquatic tissue samples, using established methods and procedures. This role requires someone who can work efficiently, maintain accurate records, safely handle samples and laboratory materials, and consistently meet deadlines and quality requirements.

Evaluate workload and prioritize samples based on holding times and due dates.

Maintain laboratory equipment.

Communicate with department managers, analytical teams, and project managers regarding job status, rush requests, sample issues, holding times, and/or other concerns.
Work efficiently to meet turnaround times and production goals.
Follow all laboratory SOPs, quality requirements, and company policies.
Learn and perform new techniques and procedures as training is provided.
Assist with other laboratory activities as needed.

Is passionate about the environment and interested in contributing to environmental testing.
Is dependable and takes pride in showing up and doing quality work.
Has experience working in a fast paced, production oriented environment.
Can consistently follow detailed instructions and established procedures.
Is comfortable performing repetitive hands on work while maintaining attention to detail.
Can work efficiently and meet deadlines without sacrificing quality.
Is willing and able to learn new techniques and laboratory procedures.

Reliable

Kelly® Science & Clinical is seeking a Research Associate, LNP Formulation for a 3-month contract-to-hire opportunity with one of our clients, a biotechnology company in South San Francisco focused on extending human health span. If you’re passionate about bringing the latest scientific discoveries to life and are ready to take the next step in your career, trust The Experts at Hiring Experts.

Position Title:
Research Associate, LNP Formulation Development

Position type: 3
-month contract-to-hire

Workplace:
Onsite in South San Francisco, CA

Pay Range:
$38 - 45 per hour

Overview

We are looking for a dynamic, driven Senior/Research Associate to join our client's pioneering Delivery Sciences team and help shape the future of nucleic acid therapeutics. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of lipid nanoparticle (LNP) development, where your expertise will directly impact the advancement of transformative gene-editing and reprogramming technologies.

What You’ll Achieve

Design, formulate, and optimize lipid nanoparticles for delivering nucleic acids across a spectrum of in vitro and preclinical models, translating fundamental science into real-world impact.
Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary Epigenetic Editing and Product teams (Immunology, Metabolism, Vascular) to innovate reprogramming therapeutics and scale up LNP solutions from proof-of-concept to production.
Develop and refine LNP compositions, purification protocols, and analytical workflows; establish robust, reproducible methodologies to ensure seamless production for a rapidly growing pipeline.
Anticipate future needs, proactively plan for formulation innovations, material sourcing, and lab readiness to support ambitious research and development initiatives.
Bring clarity to complex biological data: interpret, present, and leverage insights to drive strategic decision-making across Delivery Science and Preclinical Development.
Uphold the highest standards of scientific record-keeping in an Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN), ensuring traceable, reproducible experiments.

Who You Are

Hold an MS in Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related discipline, with 2+ years of relevant industry experience—or possess equivalent hands-on expertise.
Experienced in designing and assembling LNPs using a range of lipid chemistries and mixing technologies for nucleic acid delivery.
Skilled in purification processes, including dialysis, tangential flow filtration (TFF), ultracentrifugation, and sterile filtration.
Expert in LNP characterization, leveraging analytical technologies such as DLS, LC-UV/CAD, CGE, fragment analysis, osmolality, MALS, ELISA, and fluorescence-based plate assays.

Bonus Skills

Experience advancing drug products through preclinical or clinical development, particularly in nucleic acid delivery.
Specialized knowledge in liver biology or targeted LNP delivery to hepatocytes.
Familiarity with bioconjugation, surface modifications, or engineering LNPs with targeting moieties for cell type specificity.
Proficient in data visualization and statistical analysis tools (R, Python), enabling impactful communication and data-driven innovation.

Ensure that human research subject training is up to date for all faculty and staff involved in studies.

jobs.title: Software Engineer/ Data Science (Fall 2026, La Jolla/ San Diego Area)
jobs.description:
Allied Legacy Partners
Data Science/ Software Engineer Intern
Fall 2026 Internship • La Jolla, San Diego, CA • For Academic Credit

About the Role
We are excited to offer a Fall 2026 internship opportunity designed for college students in the La Jolla, San Diego area who are able to commute to our office. As a Data Science / Software Engineer Intern, you’ll be handling real operational problems and the latitude to figure out how technology can solve them – prototyping ideas, testing what works, and helping push forward projects that genuinely change how the company runs. We run a modern stack (CINC, a custom Supabase data platform, HubSpot, RingCentral, n8n, and Google Workspace) and we use software, AI, and automation to do more with a lean team.
We’re building toward bigger things: AI systems that handle multi-step work end-to-end, internal tools that replace software we currently pay for, a continuously running engine that sources and scores acquisition targets, and live dashboards that leadership actually makes decisions from. You’ll contribute to that vision, and the more you bring curiosity and original thinking, the more you’ll get to own. This internship is offered for academic credit in coordination with your university.
What You’ll Do
Build and test n8n automation workflows that connect our tools and eliminate repetitive manual work.
Prototype and test new ideas: take a process that’s slow or manual, propose a better way, and build a working version to see if it holds up.
Help develop AI-powered workflows using the Claude and Gemini APIs, from simple drafting and extraction toward more ambitious multi-step systems that read inputs, make decisions, and produce finished work for human review.
Run recurring data-extraction jobs, such as pulling figures from HOA financial-statement PDFs into structured spreadsheets.
Support data cleanup, entry, and validation in our Supabase platform and across spreadsheets.
Help design, build, and test internal tools and dashboards that staff use day to day: including early versions of tools that could replace software we currently buy.
Maintain data quality in HubSpot, and support the competitive-intelligence and acquisition research process by gathering, organizing, scoring, and verifying company and contact data.
Document how workflows and tools function, and take ownership of well-defined projects from start to finish.
What We’re Looking For
Outside-the-box thinking. You don’t just complete the task in front of you. Ask whether there’s a smarter way to do it, and you’re eager to test your ideas rather than wait for permission.
Self-direction. Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work independently in an unstructured, fast-paced environment with minimal hands-on oversight.
Comfort with technology. You’re not intimidated by new software, spreadsheets, or learning a tool on the fly. Exposure to any of SQL, Python, automation platforms, or AI tools is a plus, but resourcefulness and a willingness to learn matter more than a finished skill set.
Analytical aptitude. Strong analytical skills and an aptitude for breaking down data and business problems.
Communication. Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with diverse team members and explain what you built and why.
Genuine interest. Real curiosity for technology, automation, and AI, and how they can transform how a business operates.
Benefits
Gain hands-on experience with a real production stack – automation (n8n), databases (Supabase/Postgres), CRMs (HubSpot), and applied AI – skills that transfer to almost any modern company.
Work on genuinely ambitious problems, not busywork, with room to propose and test your own ideas.
Work closely with experienced professionals in a collaborative, mentorship-oriented environment.
Access valuable networking opportunities within the technology and business community.
Flexible work arrangements to accommodate academic commitments.
Real projects you can point to, plus exposure to many aspects of how a growing business runs on technology.
Potential for future career growth within the organization based on performance and alignment.
To Apply
Please submit via LinkedIn and send a resume and cover letter to david@alliedlegacypartners.com, directly to the founder. Use the following subject line:
ALP HOA Tech Intern Candidate: {Full Name}, {School}
In the cover letter, please briefly explain:
Your interest in this internship and how it fits with your current career goals.
Any relevant experience you have (coursework, work experience, projects, or things you’ve built on your own).
A time you came up with a creative or unconventional solution to a problem, or built something that didn’t exist yet.
Your ability or experience working in unstructured and ambiguous environments with minimal hands-on oversight (your ability to self-motivate and self-supervise).
Your available time commitment in person at our La Jolla, San Diego office: 20 hours per week during the school year, starting September 2026 and onward.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
Please note that all applications will be reviewed by the founder and are not automated.

jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Join the Intuit Customer Success Data Science & Analytics team as the Manager 3 leading Data Foundations. This team builds the governed, compliant data foundation that Intuit's Customer Success analytics and AI capabilities are built on. Metric definitions, clean domain entities, customer journey data products, semantic knowledge layer and the agentic tooling that keeps them healthy. You will lead a team of senior and staff-level data scientists accountable for building the Governed Data Foundation for ICS. This is a hands-on-adjacent people-leadership role. You will set technical direction, own the roadmap and its financial case, grow domain owners, and influence at the Director and VP level. The work spans two halves that must hold together: building data capabilities (consuming models, automating pipeline development and root-cause analysis, generating insights) and building the knowledge layer (understanding the data deeply enough that governed definitions and semantics can be trusted by downstream agents).This role is for someone who thrives in ambiguity, sets standards that outlast individual projects, and builds both systems and people that scale across teams and business units.

**Responsibilities**

### **Team Leadership & Talent**

* Lead, coach, and grow a team of senior, staff, and principal data scientists; develop domain leads capable of owning a data domain end to end, from source instrumentation through consumption.
* Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, calibration, and promotion advocacy for the team; build and maintain a strong talent pipeline and participate actively in A4A and talent assessment forums.
* Support craft progression across the team and raise the technical bar through review standards, documented best practices, and internal forums.
* Scale yourself through delegation and clear ownership boundaries; role-model an inclusive, high-trust environment that encourages constructive debate.

### **Strategy & Business Outcomes**

* Own the strategic vision, roadmap, success criteria, and financial case for the Data Foundations portfolio, partner with Finance and TPM to quantify and defend impact.
* Develop KPI frameworks that set direction across the organization, applying a "define once, calculate uniformly" metric standardization model across core data domains.
* Apply first-principles thinking to translate Customer Success business strategy into analytical and data-architecture problems at the Business Unit level.
* Combine insights, business acumen, and industry benchmarks to influence cross-functional leaders, represent the team's work in executive forums and organization-wide reviews.

### **Data Foundations & Governance**

* Drive a shift-left approach to data quality by embedding data design into the product development lifecycle so defects are prevented at source rather than cleaned downstream.
* Establish governed clean entities, standardized metric layers, and semantic/knowledge layers as the trusted source of truth for Customer Success data domains.
* Own end-to-end customer journey data products, stitching behavioral clickstream, contact touchpoints, and time-series journeys to pinpoint drop-offs and high-contact moments that drive cost-to-serve.
* Lead compliance and security execution for the organization's data estate by field-level access control, data-access management, and PII minimization against enterprise mandates and hard regulatory deadlines.
* Negotiate and maintain clear ownership boundaries with Data Engineering and PD partners on governed base tables, paved-path platforms, and the graduation of analyst-built assets into managed ownership.

### **AI Capabilities & Automation**

* Lead custom implementations of AI/GenAI capabilities for key business initiatives, in partnership with AI and platform teams.
* Direct the build-out of agentic data tooling for improving productivity and automation like pipeline migration and development agents, automated data-quality detection, and automated root-cause analysis targeting material reductions in downstream failures, detection time, and analyst hours spent on data bug management.
* Guide the team on measurement of AI-native experiences, connecting model performance metrics (cost, latency, accuracy, hallucination) to customer and business outcomes.
* Be a thought partner on build/buy decisions for analytics workflow tooling, and identify where new methodologies should be adopted and standardized across the organization.

**Qualifications**

### **Required**

  

* BS or MS in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics/Econometrics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
* 14+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or data platform work, including 5+ years directly managing data scientists or analytics engineers.
* Demonstrated success leading teams that deliver governed data foundations at enterprise scale metric standardization, domain/entity modeling, data quality programs, or data product ownership.
* Strong hands-on technical foundation in SQL and Python sufficient to set architectural direction, review your team's work critically, and remain credible in deep technical discussions. This role requires a leader who has coded and can still read code, not one who has moved fully into administration.
* Experience with modern cloud data platforms and pipeline orchestration, and with migrating legacy analytics estates onto governed, paved-path platforms.
* Proven track record building AI/GenAI or agentic capabilities that automate data operations like validation, quality monitoring, root-cause analysis, or insight generation.
* Demonstrated ability to define metrics that shape business strategy and to influence Director- and VP-level stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience owning a multi-million-dollar impact portfolio, including building the financial case and reporting against it in executive forums.

The work spans two halves that must hold together: building data capabilities (consuming models, automating pipeline development and root-cause analysis, generating insights) and building the knowledge layer (understanding the data deeply enough that governed definitions and semantics can be trusted by downstream agents).This role is for someone who thrives in ambiguity, sets standards that outlast individual projects, and builds both systems and people that scale across teams and business units.

**Responsibilities**

### **Team Leadership & Talent**

* Lead, coach, and grow a team of senior, staff, and principal data scientists; develop domain leads capable of owning a data domain end to end, from source instrumentation through consumption.
* Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, calibration, and promotion advocacy for the team; build and maintain a strong talent pipeline and participate actively in A4A and talent assessment forums.
* Support craft progression across the team and raise the technical bar through review standards, documented best practices, and internal forums.
* Scale yourself through delegation and clear ownership boundaries; role-model an inclusive, high-trust environment that encourages constructive debate.

### **Strategy & Business Outcomes**

* Own the strategic vision, roadmap, success criteria, and financial case for the Data Foundations portfolio, partner with Finance and TPM to quantify and defend impact.
* Develop KPI frameworks that set direction across the organization, applying a "define once, calculate uniformly" metric standardization model across core data domains.
* Apply first-principles thinking to translate Customer Success business strategy into analytical and data-architecture problems at the Business Unit level.
* Combine insights, business acumen, and industry benchmarks to influence cross-functional leaders, represent the team's work in executive forums and organization-wide reviews.

### **Data Foundations & Governance**

* Drive a shift-left approach to data quality by embedding data design into the product development lifecycle so defects are prevented at source rather than cleaned downstream.
* Establish governed clean entities, standardized metric layers, and semantic/knowledge layers as the trusted source of truth for Customer Success data domains.
* Own end-to-end customer journey data products, stitching behavioral clickstream, contact touchpoints, and time-series journeys to pinpoint drop-offs and high-contact moments that drive cost-to-serve.
* Lead compliance and security execution for the organization's data estate by field-level access control, data-access management, and PII minimization against enterprise mandates and hard regulatory deadlines.
* Negotiate and maintain clear ownership boundaries with Data Engineering and PD partners on governed base tables, paved-path platforms, and the graduation of analyst-built assets into managed ownership.

### **AI Capabilities & Automation**

* Lead custom implementations of AI/GenAI capabilities for key business initiatives, in partnership with AI and platform teams.
* Direct the build-out of agentic data tooling for improving productivity and automation like pipeline migration and development agents, automated data-quality detection, and automated root-cause analysis targeting material reductions in downstream failures, detection time, and analyst hours spent on data bug management.
* Guide the team on measurement of AI-native experiences, connecting model performance metrics (cost, latency, accuracy, hallucination) to customer and business outcomes.
* Be a thought partner on build/buy decisions for analytics workflow tooling, and identify where new methodologies should be adopted and standardized across the organization.

**Qualifications**

### **Required**

  

* BS or MS in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics/Econometrics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
* 14+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or data platform work, including 5+ years directly managing data scientists or analytics engineers.
* Demonstrated success leading teams that deliver governed data foundations at enterprise scale metric standardization, domain/entity modeling, data quality programs, or data product ownership.
* Strong hands-on technical foundation in SQL and Python sufficient to set architectural direction, review your team's work critically, and remain credible in deep technical discussions. This role requires a leader who has coded and can still read code, not one who has moved fully into administration.

jobs.description:

Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology (DEEPT) is seeking a highly skilled and self-driven **Lead Data Analyst - Product Performance & Engagement** to join the Product & Tech Analytics team. * Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with experience delivering insights to stakeholders at all levels.

* Advanced degree in Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Ability to identify and appropriately call out issues to leadership

jobs.title: Lab Technician
jobs.description:
Laboratory Technician
  
PSC Group is hiring entry-level Chemical Plant Laboratory Technicians! Support plant operations by performing precise lab tests and build a stable career in a booming industry. Join PSC for great benefits, a matching 401(k), and opportunities to grow. Apply now to become part of the PSC family!
  
  
**Job Duties & Responsibilities:**  

* Analyze process samples and final products per standard operating procedures in a timely manner to accommodate the needs of the refinery.
* Verify all data before reporting information to verify quality and ensure compliance with product specifications, test method standards, and regulations
* Coordinate sample testing with other technicians to improve turnaround time for reporting all data.
* Prioritize work based on the needs of the refinery.
* Perform special testing projects, i.e. round robins, bench blends, etc. on an as-needed basis
* Deliver routine supplies to, and gather collected samples from, process units in a timely manner to provide efficient turnaround of results.
* Ensure functionality of equipment by checking instrument and standard specific statistical quality control charts and perform periodic calibration and maintenance.
* Observe expiration dates, low reagent volumes, gas cylinder pressures, etc. to ensure adequate consumables and resources are available for all testing.
* Perform routine maintenance and troubleshooting for instrumentation to achieve maximum equipment availability.
* Maintain and update laboratory supply inventory to ensure continuity and safety of work.
* Communicate to relief all relevant information about the refinery, i.e. unit specifications and upsets, off-spec results, samples in progress and instrument problems, etc.
* Review electronic shift log at start of shift and sign-off at end of shift by adding pertinent information.
* Record test information into logbooks, verify electronically transferred data or enter results into SampleManager (LIMS) and approve Certificates of Analysis (C of A’s), as required.
* Report missing samples, problems, environmental concerns and off-spec results (when needed) to appropriate complex operators and/or Supervisor.
* Receive and conduct on-the-job training (OJT) to perform analytical techniques and methods for improving lab capability.
* Maintain corporate standards by completing computer-based training (CBT).
* Improve proficiency by reading analytical methods, adopting procedural updates, and reviewing instrument manuals and technical journals to meet personal, team and company objectives.
* Participate in relevant training events to increase personal development.
* Maintain a clean and organized work environment to promote health, safety, and work efficiency in the lab.
* Place hazardous material in proper waste containers and store all retained samples according to Basic Practice procedures.
* Transfer hazardous waste and empty solvent and reference fuel drums to the warehouse for proper disposal.

* Pass a drug screen, physical, and background check
* Wear all required PPE without restriction and pass any required medical exams
* Speak, write, read fluent English
* Regular on-site attendance and punctuality is required
* Previous military experience and proven ability to follow procedures is a plus

**Work Schedule:**  
8 - 12 Hour Rotating Shift (Days/Nights/Weekends/Holidays) - Will vary by site location

* We are a leader in product handling and site logistics for refineries, chemical producers, and marine transportation providers.
* The work we do makes a huge impact in our nation's economy. Check out our videos at PSC Group - Career Videos to learn more.
* Check out our online newsletter "The Connection" which contains articles about our work groups, recognition events, and achievements of our employees and their family members at PSC Group - Newsletter.
* Our Core Values serve as the foundation for all we do—how we conduct our business, serve our customers, and treat members of our PSC family. Learn more at PSC Group - Core Values.

**Employee Benefits:**  

* Medical insurance options with the company paying a large portion of the premiums, including affordable dental and vision plans for employees and their families
* Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance
* Matching 401(k) plan to help employees save money for retirement
* Vacation, sick leave, and holiday benefits (varies by work group)
* Incentives, discounts, and bonuses
* Industry-leading training and development programs
* On-Demand Pay, giving you early access to earned wages and more financial flexibility.

jobs.title: Gene Editing Lab Technician (2nd Shift)
jobs.description:
**Position:** Gene Editing Lab Technician

**Shift**: 2nd Shift (3pm - 11pm)

**Location:** SSF

**Type:** Full-time

  

**The Opportunity:**

Ohalo Genetics is seeking a motivated Gene Editing Lab Technician who will contribute to the advancement of plant variety development. The successful candidate will be detail-oriented, enthusiastic about hands-on work, and responsible. Prior experience in a sterile work environment, plant breeding or gene editing is a plus, but is not required. The Gene Editing Lab Technician will assist in specific duties to ensure the overall success of the gene editing laboratory. This role will involve additional responsibilities related to lab operations, plant inventory maintenance, and process development. This role is not limited to only lab work, and offers opportunities to contribute to various aspects of our lab's growth.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Protoplast Isolation, Transfection, and Culture:**
* + Perform enzymatic digestion of plant tissues (e.g., leaf, root, or callus) to isolate viable protoplasts.
  + Transfect protoplasts using PEG-mediated transfection or electroporation methods.
  + Culture transfected protoplasts to regenerate callus
  + Contribute to the continuous improvement and documentation of SOPs for protoplast workflows.
* **Microscopy and Imaging:**
* + Assess protoplast yield, viability, and cell health using fluorescence and confocal microscopy and viability dyes (e.g., FDA staining).
* **Data Recording and Analysis:**
* + Maintain accurate and detailed electronic lab notebooks (ELN) and batch records.
  + Compile and analyze experimental data using tools such as ImageJ, GraphPad Prism, or Excel.
* **Sample Preparation:**
* + Prepare samples for downstream molecular analyses, including RNA extraction, protein extraction, and genomic DNA isolation.
* **Cross-Functional Support and Collaboration:**
* + Collaborate with other Technicians, Research Associates, and Scientists on workflows, ensuring that critical processes are completed.
* **Lab Maintenance and Compliance:**
* + Follow safety protocols and institutional guidelines for working with plant tissue and enzymes.
  + Perform all tasks in a manner consistent with and in support of all company policies and practices related to safety and compliance.
  + Performs other duties as assigned

**Candidate Profile:**

* Ability to accurately follow verbal and written instructions as well as make suggestions to optimize methodologies
* Ability to sit for extended periods of time and do repetitive motions
* Ability to take a proactive approach to routine tasks
* Must be passionate about learning and enthusiastic about plants and hands-on work
* Must have a positive attitude and good interpersonal skills
* Ability to ask clarifying questions
* Ability to work independently and in a team environment with multiple departments
* Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds on intermittent basis and possess the ability to sit for extended periods of time
* Candidate must prioritize safety

**Desired skills/experience:**

* Experience working in a lab including sterile technique, micropropagation, media preparation, microscopy, and DNA extraction

  

*Below is the pay range for this position that we reasonably expect to pay. Individual compensation is based on various factors including experience, education, skillset, and other relevant qualifications. This range is for the South San Francisco, California location and may be adjusted to the labor market in other geographic areas.*

Anticipated Compensation: $33/hr

**About Ohalo:**

Ohalo™ aims to accelerate evolution to unlock nature's potential. Founded in 2019, Ohalo develops novel breeding systems and improved plant varieties that help farmers grow more food with fewer natural resources, increasing the yield, resiliency, and genetic diversity of crops to sustainably feed our population. Ohalo's breakthrough technology, Boosted Breeding™, will usher in a new era of improved productivity to radically transform global agriculture. For more information, visit www.ohalo.com.

*Notes: If you previously applied for a job at Ohalo Genetics, we encourage you to restate your interest in the position by submitting your application.*

*No recruiters, please.*

Fourier is working to make on-site hydrogen universally accessible. Our breakthrough architecture enables highly modular and automated electrolyzers that scale to any size while optimizing efficiency across operating conditions. We are on a mission to accelerate the transition to a sustainable, emission-free energy future.

This is a technical leadership role for someone who enjoys being close to the hardware and can **own the build, testing, troubleshooting, and validation of complex electrical and electronic systems**. You will work closely with electrical, power electronics, mechanical, controls, and manufacturing engineers to bring prototypes and one-of-a-kind assemblies from concept through testing and deployment, including development of internal test systems for Fourier's electrolyzer stacks.

AlivaMab Biologics is seeking an outstanding individual to join the Antibody Discovery Team. The successful candidate will serve as the Research Associate, supporting antibody discovery and screening workflows, enabling identification of antibody hits with therapeutic potential from the AlivaMab® Mouse platform, and contributing to broader technology development and companywide initiatives in collaboration with cross-functional scientific teams, working closely with scientists in Antibody Discovery, Antibody Engineering, and Protein Sciences teams. The successful candidate will be a highly motivated team player and able to multitask in an exciting, fast-paced environment, working to discover the next generation of breakthrough antibody drugs.

Responsibilities:

**Responsibilities:**

* Perform mouse immunizations, sera titer assessment, and tissue collection
* Maintain mammalian cell lines for cell-based assays across multiple projects
* Screen antibodies using ELISA, flow cytometry, and cell-based functional assays
* Prepare reagents and maintain an up-to-date inventory, including monitoring stock levels and reordering as needed
* Demonstrate initiative and creativity in experimental design, execution, and troubleshooting
* Execute high-throughput processes to support antibody discovery and screening workflows using automation
* Effectively maintain meticulous records of lab activities using an electronic notebook (Benchling); communicate findings clearly through written reports and presentations to support project progression and scientific decision-making
* Contribute innovative ideas and collaborate effectively across teams to drive research excellence and project success in a fast-paced environment

Qualifications:

**Qualifications:**

* BS or MS in immunology, cell biology, or related discipline with 0-3 years of relevant industrial or academic experience.
* Small-animal work, including immunization, blood collection, and tissue harvest performed in accordance with IACUC guidelines, is an integral part of this role. Prior hands-on experience with these procedures is an advantage.
* Aseptic mammalian tissue culture experience is required. Demonstrated expertise in culturing cancer cell lines and hybridomas is preferred.
* Ability to work efficiently, both independently and as part of a team, on challenging drug discovery projects that use high-throughput cell culture and antibody screening techniques.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and GraphPad Prism. Experience with Benchling ELN/LIMS is a plus.
* The successful candidate will be self-motivated, detail-oriented, and eager to learn and develop new skills and techniques in antibody drug discovery.
* Experience with stable cell line generation, cell sorting, and/or experimental design of cell-based assays is desired.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills with meticulous attention to detail
* Motivated self-starter with excellent organization, teamwork, and a passion for scientific innovation
* Local candidate preferred. No relocation assistance is offered for this position.

**About AlivaMab Biologics**

AlivaMab Biologics sets its partners’ antibody discovery programs on the fastest and most de-risked path through discovery and development. Trusted by top-tier pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, AMB delivers fully human antibodies on exceptional timelines. AMB achieves its partners’ design goals, from simple to extraordinarily challenging, through the generation and function-first screening of large, molecularly diverse panels of antibodies. AMB focuses on the rapid and efficient delivery of antibodies, characterized for function, kinetics, and developability, and on engineering alternative formats, including multispecifics and CARs. The AMB team’s experience and passion for antibody drug discovery and development, combined with trusted, proven technologies, including Ablexis' AlivaMab® Mouse platforms, ensure the highest probability of success.

AlivaMab Biologics provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, reproductive health decision-making, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, citizenship or immigration status, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Laboratory Assistant, Clinical Laboratory (Per-Diem, Variable Shift)
jobs.description:
Focused on growth and technological expertise since 1974, Adventist Health Delano is a full-service community and regional teaching hospital. We are comprised of a 156-bed medical center serving 10 rural Central California cities with primary and specialty care services. Delano is central to all that California has to offer and is the second-largest city in Kern County. A nice balance of small-town community and cultural diversity, Delano offers vitality and energy to our community.

Job Summary:

Collects blood specimens, as well as receives, handles and processes specimens for Laboratory testing. Receives, sorts and accessions specimens, assigning to appropriate pre-analytic and analytic workflow. Completes computerized tasks related to patient registration and/or test order entry, specimen collection, receiving and processing. Performs basic post-analytic tasks, including distributing reports, storing and/or retrieving specimens. Completes quality-related tasks such as documentation of work, maintaining a clean, stocked and safe work area, and monitoring pending work, as well as escalating priority work. Operates and/or uses basic pre-analytic lab equipment. Adheres to all local/state/federal regulations, codes, policies and procedures to ensure privacy and safety while delivering optimal patient care.

Job Requirements:

Education and Work Experience:

* High School Education/GED or equivalent: Required in CA; Preferred in OR and HI
* Associate’s/Technical Degree or equivalent combination of education/related experience: Preferred
* Experience in Phlebotomy in acute care environment: Preferred

Licenses/Certifications:

* Certified Phlebotomy Technician I (CPTI) license: Required in CA; Preferred in OR and HI

Facility Specific License/Certifications:

* Phlebotomy Tech (CPT) or Certified Phlebotomy Technician II (CPTII): Required

Essential Functions:

* Collects blood specimens for a variety of Laboratory tests using age-appropriate techniques; handles/transports Lab specimens and provides post-phlebotomy care to patients. Receives specimens for testing; assesses specimens upon receipt according to established criteria to determine acceptability and takes action according to protocol including escalating to licensed or certified personnel for direction. Handles and processes a variety of specimen types to prepare them for analysis; adheres to protocols to maintain specimen integrity at all times.
* Completes computerized tasks as appropriate for affiliate to ensure complete patient registration and/or test order entry into the lab information system, as well as generation of collection lists and/or labels. Prepares and/or packages specimens for transport to another Adventist Health or outside reference laboratory and may complete computer steps necessary for processing referred specimens.
* Maintains an adequate inventory of supplies in work area and/or on phlebotomy cart. Maintains required records by completing basic documentation of pre-analytic and post-analytic work, as well as quality-related tasks. Participates in managing the laboratory workflow by performing duties such as monitoring pending work, escalating priority work, locating specimens, and coordinating specimen recollections.
* Verbally communicates released/reported results. Routes, distributes and retransmits released/reported results. Stores and retrieves specimens.
* Receives incoming calls for the laboratory and assists the caller as appropriate or transfers these calls to the appropriate laboratory section or person. Communicates with customer to clarify ambiguous, unclear or duplicate test orders.
* Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Organizational Requirements:

Adventist Health is committed to the safety and wellbeing of our associates and patients. Therefore, we require that all associates receive all required vaccinations as a condition of employment and annually thereafter, where applicable. Medical and religious exemptions may apply.
  
  
Adventist Health participates in E-Verify. Visit https://adventisthealth.org/careers/everify/ for more information about E-Verify. By choosing to apply, you acknowledge that you have accessed and read the E-Verify Participation and Right to Work notices and understand the contents therein.

jobs.title: Senior Research Associate, Chemistry
jobs.description:
**Rapidly Growing Life Sciences Technology Company**

Ultima Genomics is a rapidly growing company that is developing ground-breaking genomics technologies. Our mission is to continuously drive the scale of genomic information to enable unprecedented advances in biology and improvements in human health. We have developed a foundational new approach to sequencing at scale that overcomes limitations due to the high costs of current technologies. We are well-funded and have raised approximately $600 million from global top-tier investors. Our team brings together unique and diverse expertise across multiple disciplines, from healthcare and life sciences, to engineering, to technology and software and beyond. We are a collaborative group, including successful entrepreneurs, chemists, hardware and software engineers, genomics and biotechnology experts, molecular and computational biologists, software and algorithm experts, and operations and commercial leaders. Join us to develop and commercialize technologies that unleash the power of genomics at scale and empower the future of human health.

We are looking for a highly motivated **Senior Research Associate, Chemistry** to join our Process Chemistry team!

This opportunity is an onsite contracting position that operates on a Friday-Monday shift (4 days x 10 hours, after initial training) based in our Fremont, CA office. In this role, you will be involved in the production of high-quality chemical intermediates and final compounds within a quality environment. The ideal candidate will be able to work with minimal supervision, hold at least a BSin Chemistry or a closely related field, and have a strong interest in applying scientific principles to real-world manufacturing processes. After training, you will be expected to identify and solve routine problems with little assistance and adhere to all industry standards and regulatory requirements.

**How You'll Contribute**

* Operate and monitor chemical production equipment to manufacture chemical intermediates and final compounds. Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and batch records to ensure accurate and consistent production
* Scale-up production of organic chemistry intermediates and purification using automated preparative liquid-chromatography (prep-LC), ion exchange chromatography, flash chromatography, and rotary evaporation
* Maintain quality standards by conducting in-process testing and analysis, by following well-established SOP assays using HPLC, UV, LCMS, pH meter, and/or fluorometer to access intermediate identity, purity, pH, and concentration
* Assist with routine maintenance of shared laboratory equipment and ensure instruments are up to date with calibration, preventative maintenance, and perform to specifications
* Assist with updating and/or writing new SOPs, and present weekly activities at chemistry meetings
* Participate in ongoing training to develop technical skills and enhance your understanding of chemical manufacturing processes
* Adhere to all safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements, including OSHA and ISO standards, to maintain a safe and compliant working environment
* Manage and maintain chemical inventory and support other teams on occasion
* Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications, Skills, Knowledge & Abilities**

* MS in Chemistry, with a minimum of 4 years of hands-on industrial experience (or BS with 5 years) in an organic or process chemistry environment
* Ability to perform small-molecule organic chemistry reactions and contribute to improving and streamlining production processes
* A collaborative team player who communicates well and is eager to contribute within cross-functional teams to support shared goals and drive organizational success
* Meticulous and detail oriented, motivated and eager to learn, ability to follow technical procedures with consistent results, and document all work performed
* Excellent organizational, communication and time management skills
* May be exposed to constant activity that requires intermittent standing, bending, crouching, pushing/pulling, lifting/moving/carrying (up to 50 lbs)

This contracting position offers an hourly pay rate between $35/hour and $/42hour, and your actual base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

jobs.description:
Join the forefront of groundbreaking research at the Beckman Research Institute of City of Hope, where we're changing lives and making a real difference in the fight against cancer, diabetes, and other life-threatening illnesses. Our dedicated and compassionate faculty and staff are driven by a common mission: Contribute to innovative approaches in predicting, preventing, and curing diseases, shaping the future of medicine through cutting-edge research.

A Clinical Research Assistant I is available within the Department of Outcomes Research. You will support the day-to-day operations of multiple clinical research protocols to ensure efficient study conduct, regulatory compliance, accurate documentation, and timely data collection. Your responsibilities will include participant prescreening, recruitment, informed consent support, study visit coordination, data entry and quality review, regulatory file maintenance, audit readiness, and communication with investigators, clinical teams, regulatory staff, sponsors, vendors, and other internal and external collaborators. * Manage multiple clinical research protocols, ensuring accurate documentation, participant registration, and compliance with study and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate all study activities, including participant scheduling, visit tracking, reminders, questionnaires, specimen workflows, device management, and protocol-specific documentation.
* Recruit, screen, enroll, consent, and follow up with study participants in accordance with protocol and institutional guidelines.
* Collect, manage, analyze, and submit study data while maintaining data integrity and adherence to protocol requirements.
* Perform protocol-specific clinical and research duties, including specimen collection, processing, handling, and safety compliance.
* Monitor research activities for protocol adherence, identify issues or deviations, and communicate findings to investigators and leadership.
* Train and mentor new clinical research staff while fostering collaborative relationships with participants, investigators, and healthcare teams.
* Function independently with minimal oversight, support special projects, maintain an efficient work environment, and engage in ongoing professional development.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Associate I - Southern California (Dermatology)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**About AbbVie**

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**

Advance AbbVie's pipeline by striving for excellence in clinical research, turning science into medicine for our patients and leveraging new advanced capabilities to drive industry leading performance.  
  
Partners with the investigator and site staff for meaningful and effective engagements positioning AbbVie as the choice in clinical trials.  
  
Focus on site clinical research that ensures appropriate conduct of the trial while driving improvement in data integrity, compliance, overall study performance and customer experience.

Responsibilities

* Considered as the primary point of contact for the investigative site, provides contextual information on the clinical trials, connects stakeholder to the investigative sites and strengthens AbbVie’s positioning.
* Aligns, trains and motivates the site staff and principal investigator under supervision on the goals of the clinical trial program, protocol, and patient treatment principles for the trial ensuring a trusted partnership.
* Conducts site evaluation, site training, routine, and site closure monitoring activities under supervision, in compliance to the protocol and monitoring plans and accordance with applicable regulations, Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), ICH Guidelines, AbbVie Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and to quality standards in conducting clinical research, ensuring safety and protection of study subjects.
* Customize site engagement strategy for assigned study (ies) under supervision. Gather local/site insights and utilize site engagement tools such as the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tool, to report/track progress and measure impact of that strategy.
* Fundamental level of competency connecting the study protocol, scientific principles and clinical trial requirements to the day-to-day clinical trial execution activities. Evaluate and ensure effective recruitment and retention techniques/plans based on the patient disease journey.  
  Develop solid knowledge of therapeutic area, asset and clinical landscape / patient journey to enable successful patient recruitment and overall protocol compliance.
* Responsible for continuous risk-assessment proactively, and in collaboration with Central Monitoring team, monitor activities conducted by clinical sites to detect early overall study performance or patient safety issues. Ability to think critically to resolve site risk signals while having robust understanding of site processes to drive study execution.
* Ensures preventative and corrective action plans are put into place, as needed, to mitigate risk and promote compliance using a customer centric approach.
* Identifies, evaluates and recommends new/potential investigators/sites under supervision and support from more experienced CRAs.
* Ensures quality of data submitted from study sites and assures timely submission of data, including appropriate reporting and follow-up for all safety events by site personnel.
* Ensures audit and regulatory inspection readiness at assigned clinical site at all times.  
  Manages investigator payments as per executed contract obligations, as applicable.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Appropriate tertiary qualification in health related disciplines (Medical, Scientific, Nursing) preferred or experience or equivalent work experience.
* Clinically related experience, preferably in clinical research coordinating or data management.
* Knowledge of appropriate therapeutic area indications is preferred with the ability to understand and apply scientific concepts as they relate to the conduct of clinical trials.
* Knowledge on existing and emerging local regulatory and legal requirements, ICH/GCP Guidelines and applicable policies.
* Able to work collaboratively and cross functionally to develop and sustain working relationships.

jobs.title: Research Associate
jobs.description:
Research Associate

**Cancer Genomics • Organoid Biology • Tumor Microenvironment**

**About the Lin Laboratory**
============================

The Lin Laboratory at USC studies the molecular mechanisms that drive cancer development, progression, immune evasion, and therapeutic response, with a particular focus on head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) and other upper aerodigestive cancers. Our research integrates cancer genomics and epigenomics with functional biology, patient-derived organoid models, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, and tumor immunology.

A major strength of the laboratory is the development and application of human organoid models. We use patient-derived tumor organoids and genetically defined organoid systems to reconstruct early malignant transformation, investigate genotype-to-phenotype relationships, model tumor-microenvironment interactions, and identify therapeutic vulnerabilities. These models are integrated with clinical specimens and multi-omic datasets to address biologically and clinically relevant questions.

The laboratory is embedded within the USC Head and Neck Center and the USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, providing a highly collaborative environment with access to clinicians, patient specimens, advanced genomic technologies, and multidisciplinary expertise. Recent work from the laboratory has included studies of patient-derived HNSCC organoids, tumor immunity, epigenetic regulation, spatial tumor architecture, and mechanisms of metastasis and therapeutic response.

**Position**
============

We are seeking a motivated Research Associate to join the Lin Laboratory and contribute to NIH-funded studies of cancer biology. The successful candidate will participate in multidisciplinary projects spanning organoid biology, molecular and cellular biology, cancer genomics, tumor immunology, and functional studies of therapeutic response.

This position is particularly well suited for a scientist who wants to work at the interface of experimental and translational cancer research. Depending on experience and interests, projects may involve patient-derived organoid culture and characterization, molecular perturbation, drug-response studies, tumor-immune co-culture, flow cytometry, histology and imaging, and integration of experimental data with single-cell or spatial genomic analyses.

**Research Environment**
========================

The Lin Laboratory is part of a highly collaborative research community on the USC Health Sciences Campus. The laboratory works closely with investigators in the USC Head and Neck Center, USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, and collaborating institutions. Team members have opportunities to develop expertise across experimental and computational approaches and to contribute to projects that connect fundamental mechanisms of cancer with patient-derived models and clinical questions.

**Qualifications**
==================

Candidates should have a PhD, MD, or equivalent doctoral degree in cancer biology, molecular biology, cell biology, genetics/genomics, immunology, bioengineering, biomedical sciences, or a related field.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

* Mammalian cell culture, primary cells, or organoid culture
* Molecular and cellular biology, including RNA/DNA analysis, western blotting, qPCR, immunofluorescence, or related methods
* Cancer biology, tumor immunology, or functional studies of therapeutic response
* Flow cytometry, microscopy, histology, or quantitative image analysis
* Genomics, transcriptomics, single-cell or spatial data analysis, or quantitative biology

Strong candidates will be intellectually curious, careful in experimental design and data interpretation, able to work independently while collaborating effectively with others, and interested in developing new experimental and analytical skills.

**Job Accountabilities**
========================

* Serves as a research trainee for the purpose of enhancing and developing research competencies. Participates in planning, designing, and conducting highly technical and complex research projects under the direction of a supervisor.
* Identifies, researches, compiles, and evaluates data sources, background information, and/or technology related to the area of specialization.
* Analyzes and evaluates research data and provides interpretations requiring significant knowledge of a specialized area of research.
* Searches the literature, utilizing available resources regarding new methodologies, and designs experiments accordingly.
* Contributes to the development of research documentation for publication and/or prepares technical reports, papers, and records.
* Operates and maintains sophisticated laboratory and scientific equipment.
* Performs other related duties as assigned or requested. The University reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

**Why Join the Lin Lab?**
=========================

This position offers the opportunity to work with human patient-derived models and clinically anchored datasets while gaining broad experience in modern cancer biology. Research Associate projects are designed to allow meaningful scientific ownership and contribution to publications and ongoing NIH-funded research programs.

**To Apply**
============

Please apply through the USC Careers system and include a curriculum vitae and a brief description of your research experience and interests. Candidates are encouraged to review the Lin Laboratory website before applying: https://sites.usc.edu/linlab/

jobs.title: Clinical Laboratory Scientist
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Health Services is seeking a Clinical Laboratory Scientist to provide laboratory services supporting student healthcare operations. The incumbent performs specimen collection, testing, processing, reporting, and record maintenance in accordance with California licensure requirements, laboratory procedures, and applicable regulations. Reporting to the Laboratory and Ancillary Services Manager, the Clinical Laboratory Scientist also supports ancillary service operations and collaborates with healthcare providers, staff, and students to promote quality, patient-centered care.

Key Responsibilities

Perform clinical laboratory testing, specimen collection, processing, analysis, reporting, and record maintenance
Conduct skin punctures and venipuncture when required, while following aseptic technique and established safety procedures
Perform quality control activities, instrument calibration and maintenance, corrective actions, and compliance documentation
Process and label specimens for in-house testing and outside laboratory services while maintaining accurate patient records
Support laboratory operations, accreditation and licensure requirements, inventory management, staff training, quality improvement activities, and patient service

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Effective communication across a variety of venues and the ability to communicate with constituents in a professional and respectful manner
General awareness of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), and a willingness to develop skills in their appropriate, responsible, and ethical use in a higher education environment, consistent with institutional policies and practices.
Thorough knowledge of the principles and practices of clinical laboratory work and the use and care of laboratory equipment
Thorough knowledge of methods and procedures involved in phlebotomy, including aseptic technique
Knowledge of the preparation, mounting, and staining of specimens, laboratory tests, and clinical laboratory quality control procedures and standards
Working knowledge of software applications used at the Student Wellness Center or the ability to quickly navigate new electronic health record and laboratory information management systems
Knowledge of laboratory safety fundamentals and OSHA Laboratory Standards
Ability to identify incongruities in test procedure and inconsistencies in reports of test results for patients
Ability to perform a variety of laboratory analyses and to evaluate information against measurable criteria
Ability to keep records and prepare various administrative and laboratory analysis reports
Ability to handle multiple tasks, organize work priorities and special projects, with the willingness to adjust and be flexible as required

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in clinical laboratory science or equivalent from an accredited institution or equivalent postsecondary education, training and experience as defined by the California Division of Laboratory Science or combination of education and experience which provides the required knowledge and abilities
Possess and maintain a valid California Clinical Laboratory Scientist license

Preferred Qualifications

At least one (1) year of experience as a CLS in an ambulatory health setting
At least one (1) year of experience with direct patient interaction and providing courteous and professional patient service
Experience with inventory management, including monitoring supply levels and placing orders in a timely manner
Experience performing venipuncture/phlebotomy

jobs.description:
U.S. Army Clinical Laboratory Scientist (71E): Bridging the Gap Between Science and Patient Care

U.S. Army Clinical Laboratory Scientists are the critical link between cutting-edge science and lifesaving patient care. By conducting essential laboratory tests, these dedicated professionals safeguard the health and well-being of Soldiers and their families. If you're a laboratory science expert seeking a career that combines your passion for science with a commitment to service, the Army offers unparalleled opportunities to make a real difference.

Outstanding Opportunities

As a Clinical Laboratory Scientist for the U.S. Army, you will be responsible for the scientific research of biological fluids, such as blood or saliva for disease prevention. You will plan and execute laboratory testing and medical research, as well as providing advice, conducting research, and managing laboratory operations. To ensure your success as a laboratory scientist, you will attend trainings, continued education programs, seminars, and conference where you will be able to learn, compare best practices, and collaborate with other top professionals in your field. And, if you choose to serve in the Army Reserve, you will be able to serve your country as needed while still supporting your community.
Regardless of how you serve, a career as an Army Clinical Laboratory Scientist allows you to serve the Army in critical ways.

Outstanding Benefits

When you join the Army Medical Service Corps, you’ll be making a difference in the lives of our Soldiers and the country at large while gaining access to invaluable opportunities, like supporting humanitarian missions, leadership training and a competitive benefit package.
Benefits may include:
★ Repayment of qualified education loans to lending institution, paid annually over a maximum of three years while serving
★ Travel opportunities, to include humanitarian missions
★ Up to 30 days of paid vacation earned annually
★ Enrollment in a military retirement system that blends the traditional legacy retirement pension with a defined contribution to service members’ Thrift Savings Plan account
★ No- to low-cost medical and dental care for you and your family
★ Commissary and post exchange shopping privileges
★ Possible specialized training assistance and monthly stipend while enrolled in an accredited residency program
★ Specialized training to become a leader in medicine

Eligibility Requirements

★ Must have a bachelor’s degree from a DA-approved accredited college or university
★ Must have a certification in Medical Technology/Medical Laboratory Science by the American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP) with one-year work experience
★ Must be a U.S. citizen for Active Duty
★ Must have a permanent U.S. residency to serve in the Army Reserve

Have questions or want more information?

To find out more information about becoming an Army Clinical Laboratory Scientist, visit www.goarmy.com/medicine .
You may also reach out to your local Army Healthcare Recruiter to learn how you can get started on your journey in Army medicine.
