About the company

A 10-person, well-funded startup building AI for markets is hiring three founding engineers. The company trains reasoning systems on social media, Reddit and prediction market data to help its traders read markets faster, and the technology is already live: it trades real money through an internal 8-figure hedge fund anchored by the founder of one of the world's largest proprietary trading firms.

The founding team includes engineers from leading AI labs and a top hedge fund, IMO medalists, and top-ranked crypto and prediction market traders. The company is backed by a $20M seed round led by a top-tier fintech and crypto venture firm, with other well-known funds and angels from prediction markets, fintech and a major Chicago trading firm.
The team is small by design. No rigid structures, high autonomy, and a strong performance culture.

Why crypto and markets engineers should look at this

Crypto runs through this company. The team actively trades crypto and prediction markets, and prediction market data sits at the core of its models. Some prediction markets run on crypto rails and settle in stablecoins onchain, while others are regulated fiat exchanges in the US. This role sits across both worlds, so engineers who understand how onchain markets behave and how regulated venues work will feel right at home.
The investors have a long history backing crypto exchanges, DeFi protocols and onchain analytics firms, and experience at a crypto-native startup or crypto trading firm is explicitly valued.

Unlike most crypto startups, there's no token and no "is this a real business" question. It's a venture-backed company running a live fund.

What you'll build

Data pipelines that turn messy, real-world signals (social, prediction market and market data) into research-ready inputs
Trading signals and the research infrastructure behind them
Automated execution systems and tooling that let the team go from idea to live experiment extremely fast
Systems across trading and HFT infrastructure, security and ML, working directly with quant and AI researchers

You'll take projects from first idea through to production and own them end to end.

Tech stack

Python:
data pipelines, signals and research tooling
C++:
low-latency execution and trading infrastructure
AI/ML:
building and deploying the reasoning models behind the prediction engine

What we're looking for

1 to 5 years of experience as a software engineer or quant developer
Degree in computer science, mathematics, statistics or physics
Exceptional Python or C++
A track record of building and shipping a project end to end, from idea to production, as the owner
Strong statistical intuition and comfort working with noisy real-world data
Experience with AI-driven development
Deep curiosity about markets and the ability to thrive in ambiguity

Backgrounds that stand out

Engineers at crypto trading firms and market makers, especially on execution, data or infrastructure
MEV searchers and DeFi bot builders with real, measurable results
Builders of trading tools, analytics or bots on prediction markets
Onchain data engineers who have also built signals or traded
Early engineers at crypto-native or fintech startups who shipped entire systems
Quant developers, or interns from firms like IMC, Citadel, Jane Street, HRT or Optiver

Exceptional new grads will be considered if they bring real-world exposure such as shipped products, real trading results or serious internships.

Frontend, product or business development
Remote or hybrid
Pure ML research. You'll work alongside researchers as the builder.

jobs.title: CAD Administrator
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **About the Role**

As an NX Cad Admin / Triage support at Anduril, you will be instrumental in establishing, maintaining, and optimizing the Siemens NX CAD environment that powers our engineering and manufacturing teams. You will support the organization and its users on the day to day activities by working side-by-side with all of our users to support their needs, ensuring that designers and engineers have reliable, performant, and standardized tools to rapidly innovate. Your expertise will directly contribute to our ability to design, iterate, and deliver cutting-edge defense solutions at speed and scale.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop, implement, monitor, and optimize the Siemens NX CAD environment, including templates, customization files, role-based configurations, and default settings across the organization.
* Provide specialized technical support for CAD software applications used by our design and engineering teams (e.g., [NX, SolidWorks]).
* Manage the incoming IT helpdesk queue [e.g., Jira Service Desk], ensuring tickets are triaged, categorized, and assigned correctly.
* Resolve Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support tickets related to CAD/PLM software issues.
* Meet or exceed established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for ticket response and resolution times.
* Onboard new hires by setting up CAD-capable workstations, user accounts, and software permissions.
* Create, organize, and maintain user-facing self-service documentation and internal IT knowledge base articles.
* Provide technical leadership and structured training to engineering and design teams; mentor less experienced users and serve as the primary point of escalation for NX-related issues.
* Coordinate configuration and improvement projects with engineering, manufacturing, IT, quality, and Siemens/external service providers; act as the technical point of contact for significant CAD/PLM issues.
* Lead or champion reliability, capability, and continuous improvement projects related to the CAD/PLM environment; quantify benefits, document outcomes, and implement sustainable improvements.
* Ensure CAD configuration activities comply with site security, quality, and regulatory standards; assess and mitigate operational and data-security risks related to the engineering toolset.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Associate degree or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Drafting/Design, or equivalent work experience.
* Experience: 2–4 years of experience in an IT helpdesk/technical support role.
* CAD Experience: Minimum 1–2 years of experience supporting or directly using CAD platforms (NX, SolidWorks) in a professional environment.
* Working knowledge interpreting NX Logs/Sys Logs
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with all levels of the organization.
* Problem-Solving: Excellent troubleshooting skills with a methodical approach to diagnosing complex software conflicts.
* Communication: Ability to explain complex technical issues to both highly technical engineers and non-technical staff.
* Customer Service: A patient, empathetic, and helpful attitude toward end-users under tight deadlines.
* Organization: Strong multitasking skills to manage a high volume of tickets while prioritizing critical CAD-stoppage issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience administering Teamcenter PLM, including workflow, BOM, and access configuration.
* Multi-skilled experience administering and configuring Siemens NX with advanced troubleshooting capability across CAD, CAM, and CAE environments.
* Experience configuring NX templates, customization files, role-based settings, and standardized environments for multi-user deployments.
* Capable of obtaining U.S. Secret security clearance

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

jobs.title: Dutch Subject Matter Expert – Audio Transcription (AI Training)
jobs.description:
About The Role

What if your deep command of Dutch and your leadership instincts could directly shape how AI learns to understand spoken language? We're looking for a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to lead our Dutch audio transcription project. You'll oversee a team of language labelers and reviewers, provide linguistic guidance, and help ensure consistent, accurate, and high-quality output across the project.

This is a hands-on leadership role that rewards sound judgment, clear communication, and a sharp ear for language. You'll guide a team through the natural messiness of real-world audio while keeping quality standards high and the team aligned.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: Hours may vary based on project demands, team needs, and project volume

What You'll Do

Lead and support a team of Dutch-specific labelers and reviewers throughout the project
Serve as the primary language and project subject matter expert, providing guidance on transcription, labeling, and language-specific questions
Ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality standards are maintained across all project work
Monitor team performance and identify recurring quality issues, trends, or areas requiring additional guidance
Conduct regular audits of labeling and reviewing work and provide actionable feedback
Manage project-related communications and questions through Discord
Host Office Hours to answer questions, clarify guidelines, and provide ongoing support to the labeling and reviewing teams
Help identify ambiguities or gaps in project guidelines and escalate issues when necessary
Participate in team meetings, calibration sessions, and project discussions
Support alignment between labelers and reviewers to ensure consistent application of project guidelines
Communicate important project updates, changes, and quality expectations to the assigned language team
Collaborate with Project Operators and Project Managers to address quality, workflow, and performance concerns

Who You Are

Native proficiency in Dutch, with a strong grasp of Dutch regional variation and contemporary spoken usage across the Netherlands
Strong understanding of Dutch grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, and natural spoken usage
Experience with audio transcription, data labeling, linguistic annotation, quality assurance, or AI/ML data projects preferred
Strong attention to detail and ability to identify subtle linguistic, transcription, or labeling errors
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Dutch
Experience providing feedback, coaching, or leading teams is preferred
Comfortable working independently and managing multiple project priorities
Familiarity with Discord or similar online collaboration platforms

Nice to Have

Familiarity with Dutch dialectal variation — from Hollands and Brabants to Limburgs
Background in linguistics, education, translation, or communications
Prior experience working with AI training pipelines or annotation platforms

Why Join Us

Lead a team on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
Fully remote and flexible work
Shape how AI understands and processes spoken Dutch for millions of people
Build specialized leadership and quality-assurance skills in AI data pipelines
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

jobs.title: Financial Modeling Expert — AI Reviewer (Python & US Finance)
jobs.description:
About The Role

What if your deep knowledge of financial modeling could directly shape how AI performs the work of a professional analyst? We’re looking for Finance Subject Matter Experts with strong financial market knowledge who also know their way around Python and GitHub to audit, refine, and improve AI-generated financial modeling tasks — making sure they mirror how real analysts actually work.

You’ll review AI task instructions and scoring rubrics, then roll up your sleeves and edit Markdown files and Python scripts directly via Pull Requests to fix logic errors, close clarity gaps, and ensure every task meets professional standards. If you can build a DCF in your sleep and know your way around a P&L, this role was made for you.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. Candidates must have strong US-based financial knowledge and fluency with American financial terminology and conventions.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Audit AI-generated financial modeling tasks to ensure they accurately replicate professional analyst workflows
Validate task instructions and scoring rubrics for logical soundness, completeness, and real-world relevance
Directly edit Markdown files and Python scripts via Pull Requests to resolve logic errors, ambiguity, or clarity gaps
Evaluate whether AI outputs reflect correct application of concepts like DCF analysis, P&L interpretation, financial statement modeling, and valuation techniques
Provide clear, structured feedback grounded in professional financial expertise
Collaborate asynchronously with a distributed team using GitHub-based workflows
Work independently on task-based assignments at your own pace and schedule

Who You Are

Deep subject matter expertise in finance — you've worked as an analyst, in investment banking, corporate finance, equity research, FP&A, or a closely related field
Strong command of US-based financial terminology and frameworks (DCF, P&L, balance sheet analysis, WACC, comparable company analysis, etc.)
Proficient in Python — comfortable reading, writing, and debugging scripts used for financial calculations
Experienced with GitHub — you can clone repos, create branches, and submit Pull Requests without hand-holding
Comfortable editing Markdown for technical documentation
Detail-oriented with a systematic, quality-driven approach to review work
Clear, precise written communicator who can articulate what's wrong and why
Self-motivated and reliable when working independently

Nice to Have

CFA, CPA, ACCA, or MBA with a finance concentration
Professional experience building financial models in Excel or Python for deal evaluation, forecasting, or valuation
Experience working with US-listed companies, US GAAP reporting, or cross-border transactions
Background in teaching, mentoring, or creating training materials for financial concepts
Familiarity with AI/ML evaluation workflows or data annotation projects
Experience writing or reviewing technical rubrics or assessment criteria

Why Join Us

Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, high-impact task-based work
Apply your hard-earned financial expertise to a genuinely novel problem — teaching AI to think like a real analyst

Company Description
THEOIS is a global organization focused on designing innovative, core-plus intellectual property solutions for individuals, institutions, and governments. The company develops novel ways to understand and respond to trends, complex situations, and broader life experiences. As an incorporated trustee of the scientific aspect of the Council of Nicaea, THEOIS is committed to exploring the next layer of human existence. Its mission emphasizes creating systemized, scalable solutions that meaningfully enhance the human experience and have wide real-world applicability.

Role Description - THEOIS
 is recruiting Computer Vision Trainers to help improve MIA [Merging Intelligence Artificially] , an AI system that catalogues items from screen recordings.

MIA's recognition engine learns from real screen content. Your job is to produce the ground-truth labels that teach it what it is looking at — and correct it when it gets things wrong. This is not survey work and not generic data entry. You will be working directly on the accuracy of a system that ships to real users.

Open to all backgrounds. No degree, no technical experience, no prior training required.

What you'll actually do

Run screen-recording sessions through the PRAIA app as part of your normal daily phone use
Review the items MIA detects and label them correctly — product type, category, visible attributes
Correct misidentifications, missed items, and bounding-box errors flagged by the system
Rate your own confidence so the model learns where it is weak
Maintain consistent daily output

What you're not doing
No surveys. No transcription. No sales, outreach, or customer contact. Your output is a labelled dataset — that is the whole job.

Open to all backgrounds, anywhere
Must own a working smartphone with reliable internet
Must be able to commit 3–4 hours per day, consistently
Comfortable reviewing and correcting visual content at speed

Guaranteed base rate per verified session — paid from your first day, regardless of accuracy score
Monthly quality bonus for trainers who maintain high labelling accuracy and consistent output
Growth path — top performers are invited to become QA reviewers or team leads, with a rate increase

Applications are open. Shortlisted applicants complete a short 15–20 minute calibration task, and successful candidates are invited to a paid onboarding session before starting work.

Join our **AI & Engineering** team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.  
  
**AI & Engineering** leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
As an **AI and Data Science Engineer II** on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for driving technology-focused client delivery across complex engagements.  

* Engage with client stakeholders and sponsors, acting as the primary technical point of contact for your workstream
* Deliver components of client engagements spanning solution design, prototyping, testing, and production rollout
* Lead small teams through business requirements gathering, functional design, process mapping, and support-model definition, providing technical direction throughout
* Monitor progress against plan, identify variances, and drive corrective action before issues affect delivery
* Identify risks, assumptions, and constraints early, and implement approved mitigations to protect delivery
* Maintain clear, consistent communication with client stakeholders and internal engagement leadership

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  
**The team**  
  
Our **AI & Data** practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
**Required:**  

* 2+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, or Generative AI, including developing or prototyping LLM applications using LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG, or vector retrieval
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with Python and SQL across enterprise data, analytics, and machine learning platforms
* 1+ year of experience developing enterprise data products, data models, automated analytics pipelines, and decision-support solutions for reporting, trend analysis, traceability, or root-cause analysis
* 1+ year experience leading workstreams or small delivery teams within technology engagements
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field
* Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

  
**Preferred:**  

* Experience in consulting or other client-facing delivery roles
* Experience using Claude through one or more of the following: Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or the native Anthropic API
* Experience designing or implementing production agentic workflows involving capabilities such as orchestration, tool integration, state management, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls
* Professional certification(s) in Generative AI, machine learning, or cloud AI technologies, such as Anthropic Claude, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, Google Cloud Generative AI Leader, Microsoft Azure AI, or CompTIA AI+.
* Experience developing client-facing materials for workshops and interactive sessions
* Experience presenting technical content to technical and nontechnical audiences in both small- and large- group settings

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $91,100 to $179,500.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Lab Technician
jobs.description:
**About Aura Diagnostics**

Aura Diagnostics is a veterinary technology startup developing a cancer screening test for dogs. Veterinary clinics mail us nail clippings from their patients, and we analyze them in our Petaluma lab. Our first validation study was published in a peer-reviewed journal, and we're now preparing for commercial launch.

**About the role**

We're hiring one or two part-time technicians to prepare and scan the nail samples that arrive at our lab. You'll work independently and set your own schedule within lab hours. The work is repetitive and exacting: each sample has to be handled the same way every time and recorded correctly, because a veterinarian will rely on the result. If you like quiet, focused, hands-on work and take pride in getting details right, this job will suit you.

Students are welcome to apply. We'll work around your school schedule.

**What you'll do**

* Prepare nail samples for scanning using a scalpel blade and tweezers
* Load samples into the instrument and run scans
* Enter sample and patient information into our computer system exactly as provided
* Check each sample's label against its record before and after scanning
* Keep your workstation, tools and sample storage clean and organized
* Report any damaged, mislabeled or unusual samples

**What we're looking for**

Required:

* Steady hands and comfort doing fine work with small tools
* Attention to detail
* Accurate data entry and basic computer skills
* Ability to do repetitive tasks carefully for several hours at a time
* Ability to work independently and follow written procedures
* Availability for 15–20 hours per week

No previous lab experience is required. We'll train you on our instruments and procedures.

**Schedule and pay**

* 15–20 hours per week with flexible hours, including around class schedules
* $22 per hour
* This is a part-time hourly position. It does not include health insurance.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with your resume. Please include a sentence or two about any experience you have with detailed-oriented work.

Pay: $22.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

Who You’ll Work With

Slalom Chesapeake is currently searching for a dynamic and outcome-focused Sales Executive based in the DMV. This role will drive results by building a well-managed, profitable, and growing book of Technology and Business Advisory opportunities in our Healthcare and Life Sciences portfolio. Successful candidates are passionate about identifying new client opportunities and growing the Slalom brand, while helping us delight our clients and have a positive impact on their business.

What You’ll Do

Manage the full sales cycle including creating the Sales Strategy and GTM roadmap
Develop deep partnerships with the Slalom teams and the local market leadership
Build account entry strategies and execute on them
Work with new and existing clients to build a pipeline and secure new MSAs
Activity and relationship-focused approach with the end goal of driving results
Develop and share sales collateral
Manage negotiations of the opportunities in the pipeline
Be embedded in the DC community through leading and hosting events and marketing campaigns

Primary liaison with some of our clients’ most senior executives

Partner with clients to understand their needs and recommend solutions that add value to their business

What You’ll Bring

Experience selling team-based solutions in a consulting environment

Experienced in building relationships with CXOs and business decision-makers

A passion for sales, technology, and business transformation

About Us

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.
What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.

Compensation and Benefits

Slalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. For Sr Sales Executive, the base salary pay range is $150,000 to $180,000. In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. jobs.title: Senior R&D Technician, Space PV Prototyping
jobs.description:
At Tandem PV, we are a team of people who are passionate about building a more sustainable world by bringing cost effective solar panels onto the market. We’re scaling metal-halide perovskite solar technology to make best-in-class mechanically stacked tandem modules. We have built efficient, durable cells, monolithic multi-cell submodules, and packaged modules with our scalable, low-cost process. Our next focus is expanding our team to work in our new pilot manufacturing facility.

**Job Summary:**

As a Senior R&D Technician, Space PV Prototyping, you will work with our engineers and technicians to build prototype solar devices for spacecraft on ultrathin and flexible substrates: preparing substrates, running deposition, coating and patterning tools, laminating covers, and measuring results. Much of what you handle is a fraction of a millimeter thick and hard to replace, so careful execution, exact adherence to written procedures and meticulous records are central to the role. Your work produces the consistent, well-documented sample sets that our development and test campaigns depend on.

**To be great at this role, you will have:**

* Clean, inspect, photograph and log substrates, and keep accurate inventory of limited, high-value materials.
* Load and run sputter and evaporation processes, including bake-outs and controlled pump-down and vent sequences.
* Coat and thermally process device layers to fixed recipes, and flag anything that looks different from previous runs.
* Set up and run laser patterning steps, then inspect the result under a microscope and measure electrical isolation.
* Laminate cover materials, including very thin ones, and inspect for voids and edge-seal quality; handle ultrathin substrates and release them from carriers once formally qualified.
* Perform routine metrology: sheet-resistance mapping, transmittance, profilometry, optical microscopy, luminescence imaging and current-voltage measurement.
* Keep run logs and per-part travelers (tools, recipes, temperatures, vacuum cycles, operator, timestamps), and prepare and ship sample batches to external test partners.
* Build, label, mount and wire coupon sets for test campaigns and exposure chambers, and perform routine tool care, including early warning when a tool starts to drift.

**Qualifications:**

* Steady hands and patience for delicate manual work; this is the single most important qualification for the role.
* Meticulous documentation habits: detailed, legible and consistent notes of processing conditions.
* Follows written procedures exactly, and speaks up when a procedure does not match what is actually in front of you.
* Problem-solving orientation and the ability to work autonomously once trained, as part of a team in a scientific or technical environment.
* Adaptability across a wide range of laboratory tasks and willingness to learn new concepts, tools and measurements.
* Comfortable with basic laboratory arithmetic, unit conversion, and reading a specification or drawing.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, including working in a cleanroom environment while wearing required PPE and gowning; working on your feet for extended periods as required by laboratory activities; occasionally lifting, carrying, or moving materials weighing up to approximately 25 pounds; and safely working in laboratory and manufacturing environments where solvents, chemicals, and Class 4 laser systems may be present. Employees will be required to follow applicable safety procedures and complete required safety training.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Laboratory, cleanroom, semiconductor, display or precision manufacturing background, including handling thin glass, silicon wafers or display panels.
* Operation of vacuum systems, thermal evaporation or sputter deposition, solution coating (blade or slot-die), or laser tools.
* Experience in an ISO 9001, AS9100 or similarly controlled environment, or with fine assembly, soldering, precision dispensing or hermetic sealing.

This position may require access to technology and/or technical data subject to U.S. export-control laws. Any eligibility or access requirements will be applied in accordance with applicable U.S. export-control laws, regulations, licenses or authorizations, government-contract requirements, and applicable anti-discrimination laws.

Tandem PV uses perovskite & silicon mechanically-stacked tandems to upgrade silicon solar panels, sharply decreasing installed systems costs, significantly increasing module manufacturing profit margins, and opening up vast new solar markets in the US and worldwide. TPV was co-founded by Stanford PhDs Colin Bailie and Chris Eberspacher; is advised by industry experts from Corning, First Solar, Vivint Solar, and Kateeva; has raised more than $50M in Series A funding. We were recently recognized as the Best Pre-Commercial Venture of 2025 by the Industry Growth Forum (IGF)

We are a team of people who are passionate about building a more sustainable world by delivering a new generation of solar panels to the market. We are constantly growing and are always looking for dedicated, hardworking, and empathetic teammates.

Tandem PV is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

The USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center at the University of Southern California was founded in 1971 and has been continuously designated by the National Cancer Institute as a Comprehensive Cancer Center since 1973. The Flow Cytometry and Immune Monitoring Core (FCIM) at USC Norris Cancer Center s is seeking a lab assistant who can support core operation and maintenance. jobs.title: Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
**Laboratory Technician**  
  
**Caltech**

**Job Category:** Fulltime Regular  
**Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Overtime Eligible  
**Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based
  
  
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
A Caltech Lab is seeking a Laboratory Technician to support the day-to-day technical operations of its cleanroom facilities on the Caltech campus.  
  
The Technician will help maintain and organize the cleanroom labs - wet/dry labs, mechanical equipment rooms, and supply and chemical storage areas - keeping supplies well stocked and daily operations running smoothly for the lab's research team, while working closely with senior technicians and equipment engineers.  
  
The Technician will assist with routine, hands-on tasks and gradually take on greater responsibility - including nanofabrication equipment maintenance and facilities coordination - as they build experience. Overall, the Technician is expected to contribute to the lab's culture and capabilities and grow into a more developed technician role over time.  
  
**Essential Job Duties**  
**Facilities monitoring and coordination:**  

* Monitor lab facility systems (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, compressed gas, and DI water lines) for signs of malfunction - unusual noise, temperature drift, leaks, alarms - and report issues promptly to the Lab Manager and/or Caltech Facilities.
* Track critical environmental parameters (temperature, humidity, particle counts, gas levels) that affect equipment performance and researcher safety, and escalate deviations quickly.

**Inventory and procurement:**  

* Organize and perform inventory counts of stockroom supplies, including equipment, maintenance spares, consumables, PPE, chemicals, gas cylinders, and other hazardous and nonhazardous materials.
* Place orders for consumables and coordinate delivery with vendors. Flag vendor issues (communication, quality, lead time) to the lab supervisor and help resolve them.

**Lab standards and documentation:**  

* Maintain the cleanroom's hygiene standards, keeping workspaces organized and clean. Coordinate routine cleaning with vendors.
* Keep organized data records, troubleshooting documentation, and standard operating procedures to track equipment performance and guide future maintenance.
* Support broader lab safety practices alongside the Lab Safety Officer.
* Help identify and implement process improvements across equipment maintenance and lab operations.

**Communication and lab culture:**  

* Communicate progress and problems to the supervisor via email/phone, in meetings, and in reports, matching the format to the urgency and scope.
* Raise difficult or uncomfortable issues (e.g., equipment damage, missed protocols, delays) as soon as they're identified - early transparency protects the lab and its researchers more than a delayed or filtered report.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  
**Experience and technical skill:**  

* Willingness to learn equipment operation, basic maintenance, and lab procedures in a cleanroom environment; prior hands-on experience (school, hobby, work, or military) is a plus but not required.
* Basic mechanical aptitude and comfort using hand tools and basic measurement instruments.
* Proficiency with Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.

**Work style and collaboration:**  

* Attention to detail and a willingness to learn problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Willingness to maintain highly organized data records.
* Ability to learn quickly and take direction from senior technicians and the lab supervisor.
* A desire to meet high standards and grow into greater responsibility over time.
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks, with increasing responsibility.
* Strong communication skills with the supervisor, vendors, and lab users.
* Teamwork skills and an ability to collaborate with coworkers having diverse skills and backgrounds.

**Schedule and physical requirements:**  

* On-site during peak hours (8am-5pm, Monday through Friday), with the ability to work early mornings, evenings, and weekends when necessary.
* Able to work in a cleanroom setting, following all established protocols for gowning, PPE, and safety.
* Able to lift up to 20 lbs.

  
**Required Documents**  

* Resume

  
  
  
**To be considered for this position please visit our web site and apply on line at the following link:** **https://hr.caltech.edu/work/job\_openings**  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

Please visit www.stfrancismedicalcenter.com for more information. Join an award-winning team of dedicated professionals committed to compassion, quality, and service!

  
Responsibilities:

CPT I must meet the regulatory requirements of CA Codes (Business and Professions Code: 1246); (California Code of Regulations: 1034) or state regulatory certification requirements to work in the clinical laboratory. The Certified Phlebotomy Technician I primarily perform skin puncture or venipuncture on patients of all ages for the purpose of obtaining a blood specimen for analysis in the clinical laboratory and is under the supervision of Laboratory Director / Manager / Supervisor. The CPT I; 1) performs computer data entry, filing, telephone communication and other clerical duties, 2) possesses adequate knowledge of the terminology of tests ordered in the laboratory, 3) demonstrates good communication skills and telephone etiquette in greeting patients and other visitors in a polite and friendly manner, 4) demonstrates proper phlebotomy technique and the use of equipment in collecting specimens from newborns to geriatric patients, 5) processes microbiology, immunology, hematology, coagulation, urinalysis, chemistry and blood bank specimens, 6) processes specimens for referral to reference laboratories, 7) stocks routine supplies, 8) maintains the cleanliness of storage areas, trays, centrifuges, refrigerators, freezers and work areas, 9) processes or load specimens on automated laboratory instrumentation in accordance with established policy and procedures, 10) May be assist to Pick up samples at hospital/ OR, assist lab specialty in sorting out samples for analysis and put away samples, assist pathology, inventory, replenish supplies, order supplies, mail pick up/ delivery, faxing, answering phone, product deliveries, etc.. 11) other tasks or responsibilities may be assigned by the department manager/director.

jobs.title: Research Lab Technician II
jobs.description:
USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center is seeking a Research Lab Technician II to join the Preclinical Models Shared Resource (PMSR) core facility. The Research Lab Technician II will support the day-to-day operations of PMSR, a shared core facility within the USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center that provides preclinical oncology research services to investigators across USC. PMSR supports multiple investigator-initiated projects through the delivery of high-quality preclinical research services.

The position will conduct and assist with in vivo preclinical studies using mouse models. The technician is responsible for performing animal procedures, collecting biological samples, maintaining accurate animal and study records, and ensuring compliance with institutional IACUC protocols and animal welfare regulations. The technician will assist with the design and execution of preclinical studies. The position will interact with multiple investigators and work closely with other USC Norris core facilities.

The ideal candidate will have experience with oncology mouse models, strong technical skills in rodent procedures, excellent organizational abilities, and a commitment to generating high-quality preclinical data in a collaborative core facility environment.

**Essential job duties include, but are not limited to:**

* Independently perform preclinical in vivo research studies following approved protocols.
* Monitor and evaluate animal health, welfare, and protocol endpoints.
* Perform routine mouse procedures such as handling, restraint, identification, measurements, injections, blood collection, surgeries, imaging and euthanasia.
* Collect, process, and maintain biological specimens for downstream analyses.
* Maintain accurate experimental records and prepare study reports.
* Maintain laboratory equipment and inventory; order supplies as needed.
* Interact with investigators to assess research needs, coordinate services and communicate study progress.
* Assist in maintaining standard operating procedures and IACUC protocols.
* Prepare service quotes, generate invoices, and perform billing activities.
* Perform other related duties as needed.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Biology, Biomedical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
* Experience working with laboratory mice or other small laboratory animals.
* Demonstrated proficiency in small animal handling techniques and procedures.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Minimum two years of laboratory animal research experience, including hands-on experience with laboratory mice.
* Proficiency in advanced mouse procedures such as tail vein injections and survival surgeries.
* Familiarity with preclinical models for oncology research.
* Experience working in an academic core facility, or academic research environment.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with investigators and multidisciplinary teams.

Follows established USC and department policies, procedures, objectives, performance improvement, attendance, safety, environmental, and infection control guidelines, including adherence to the workplace Code of Conduct and Compliance Plan.

This position is on-site and employee must report to work at the USC Health Science Campus in Los Angeles, CA when scheduled. Work hours and on-site days may be subject to change depending on business needs.

The hourly rate range for this position is **$25.71 - $28.00**. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

Minimum Education: Associate's degree, Specialized/technical training, Combined experience/education as substitute for minimum education  
Minimum Experience: 2 years  
Minimum Field of Expertise: Working knowledge of laboratory equipment and research protocols. Knowledge of computer analysis techniques and ability to provide routine analysis and interpretation of research data.

jobs.title: Marketing Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**JOB PURPOSE:**

The Hoover Institution at Stanford University is seeking an **Audience & Marketing Insights Analyst** to join its Marketing and Communications team. The role is part marketing analyst, part analytics engineer: the analyst builds the pipelines and data models that connect Hoover’s platforms, then uses that data to answer four questions:

**Who are we reaching?** Which audiences is Hoover reaching across its website, email, video, podcasts, social platforms, events, and paid media, and how effectively is it reaching the audiences most important to its mission?

**What resonates?** Which content, campaigns, fellows, topics, and formats meaningfully connect with those audiences, and why?

**What deepens relationships?** Which actions and experiences move people from a single encounter with Hoover to repeat engagement, subscriptions, event attendance, and a lasting, direct relationship with the Institution?

**What should we do differently?** How should those insights change Hoover’s decisions about content, distribution, audience acquisition, and marketing investment?

The analyst will move beyond reporting what happened to explain why it happened, what it means, and what Hoover should do next. Success in this role is measured not by the volume of analysis produced, but by the quality of the decisions it informs.

The ideal candidate pairs genuine marketing judgment (about how audiences discover ideas, how content and campaigns are planned and distributed, and how marketing teams make decisions) with the hands-on technical skills to build and use the data foundation behind that judgment: connecting Hoover’s platforms through APIs and ELT pipelines, modeling data in BigQuery and Dataform, interpreting GA4 and HubSpot data correctly, and applying the right statistical tests.

This position reports to the Senior Manager, Digital Growth Strategy and works cross-functionally across Hoover’s Marketing and Communications organization.

**CORE DUTIES**

**Data Infrastructure & Pipelines**

Build and maintain automated ELT pipelines that bring data from HubSpot, GA4, social, video, podcast, paid media, and event platforms into BigQuery through APIs and native integrations, replacing manual exports.

Organize marketing and audience data in BigQuery using a medallion architecture, developing Dataform transformations that turn raw and semi-structured data (such as the GA4 event export and JSON API responses) into cleaned, reporting-ready tables.

Document data models, shared identifiers, transformation rules, and metric definitions in a data dictionary so that marketing, audience, CRM, web, and content data connect reliably.

Monitor pipelines and data freshness so that failures are caught before they affect reporting, and manage code in Git and GitHub so the work stays reproducible, maintainable, and transferable to others.

Handle audience and contact data, credentials, and system access responsibly and in accordance with Stanford privacy and information security policies and applicable regulations.

**Measurement & Tracking**

Ensure campaigns, content, and audience initiatives launch with appropriate tracking, tagging, and measurement plans, and maintain consistent campaign naming and UTM conventions.

Define GA4 event and data layer specifications in partnership with web developers, and QA tracking implementations using tools such as Google Tag Manager preview mode and GA4 DebugView.

Resolve tracking and data-quality issues with Hoover’s web team and external partners, and investigate discrepancies between GA4, HubSpot, and platform-reported figures before conclusions are presented to stakeholders.

**Audience Intelligence: Reach, Resonance & Relationships**

Characterize who Hoover is reaching (for example, by geography, profession, content interests, and relationship with Hoover) and how effectively it reaches its priority audiences, using CRM, web, platform, event, and survey data.

Develop measurement frameworks, KPIs, and benchmarks for reach, resonance, and relationships that distinguish high-volume activity (passive impressions and views) from engaged reading, viewing, and listening.

Analyze cross-channel audience journeys from social media, search, paid media, video, podcasts, and earned exposure into Hoover-owned channels such as Hoover.org, email, and events.

Develop audience cohorts and segments based on acquisition source, content interests, behavior, and relationship with Hoover.

Identify which topics, fellows, formats, and campaigns attract new audiences and generate repeat engagement, and which actions (such as newsletter sign-ups, return visits, and event attendance) signal and drive deeper relationships.

**Campaign Performance & Marketing Investment**

Conduct pre-, during-, and post-campaign analyses to assess performance against defined objectives and identify opportunities for improvement.

Determine which campaign elements (audience, creative, message, fellow, topic, platform, format, and timing) contribute most to performance, building institutional knowledge about what works, for whom, and under what circumstances.

Measure the incremental impact of paid promotion, using holdout groups, geographic tests, or platform lift studies where feasible, and distinguish paid, organic, earned, and direct audience activity.

Analyze marketing costs and outcomes, including cost per engaged visitor, new subscriber, and event registrant, to inform evidence-based budget allocation.

Partner with marketing leadership to establish campaign objectives and measurement plans before major initiatives launch.

**Experimentation & Testing**

Design and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across email, web, landing pages, paid media, messaging, and creative.

Define hypotheses, primary success metrics, minimum detectable effects, and required sample sizes (through power analysis) before launch, then apply the appropriate statistical tests to evaluate results for both statistical

jobs.description:
Looking to join a passionate team dedicated to developing and manufacturing life-saving biopharmaceuticals? Avid Bioservices is a leading clinical and commercial biologics CDMO focused on creating innovative solutions to meet the needs of our clients and improve patient outcomes.  
  
**Your Role:**  
The **Research Associate, Formulation Development** independently plans and executes formulation-development studies supporting protein-based biologics, including monoclonal antibodies (mAbs), across preclinical and clinical programs. Applying advanced scientific knowledge acquired through a specialized course of study, the role interprets formulation and stability data, investigates atypical results, and recommends scientifically supported next steps. Working with limited day-to-day supervision, the Research Associate owns assigned studies and deliverables and serves as a technical resource to development teams.  
  
Key Responsibilities:

* Independently plan and execute formulation-development studies, including buffer and excipient preparation, protein concentration measurements and diafiltration, vial fills, stability studies, and analytical characterization, within established program objectives.
* Generate and interpret analytical data such as pH, conductivity, protein concentration, turbidity, viscosity, SEC-HPLC, CEX, and icIEF, applying scientific judgment to evaluate results.
* Investigate atypical or unexpected formulation and stability results, assess data quality and validity, and recommend scientifically supported next steps.
* Troubleshoot routine formulation, method, sample, and instrument issues and determine appropriate technical resolutions within the role’s authority.
* Author and revise protocols, technical reports, development summaries, and investigation documentation to maintain data integrity and traceability.
* Present formulation conclusions and recommendations to Process Development and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of formulation approaches, laboratory efficiency, data quality, and turnaround time.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a biological or physical science, such as biochemistry or chemistry, providing the advanced knowledge required to perform the formulation-development work.
* One or more years of relevant hands-on laboratory experience with demonstrated working knowledge of scientific principles, or equivalent experience gained through advanced scientific coursework or internships.
* Demonstrated ability to apply scientific principles to plan studies, interpret data, investigate atypical results, and recommend technical next steps.
* Hands-on experience with protein-based biologics, formulation development, protein purification, or analytical characterization.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in biochemistry, chemistry, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience with monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and stability study design.
* Experience with SEC-HPLC, CEX, icIEF, or comparable analytical characterization techniques.
* Experience authoring protocols, technical reports, or development summaries.

**Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:**

This role is a full-time, exempt, onsite position in Tustin, CA. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. unless otherwise stated by Supervisor. The employee must also have the ability to work overtime and/or weekends when necessary.

jobs.title: Research Assistant
jobs.description:
**Research Assistant**  
  
**Caltech**

**Job Category:** Parttime Temporary  
**Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Overtime Eligible  
**Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based
  
  
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
The Darkwah-Oppong Lab in the Division of Physics, Mathematics and Astronomy seeks a Research Assistant to join an experimental Atomic, Molecular, and Optical (AMO) physics laboratory focused on quantum science with neutral atoms. The group builds and operates optical tweezer arrays of individually trapped, laser-cooled neutral atoms to study quantum simulation, quantum metrology, and many-body physics. The successful candidate will contribute to the construction, operation, and improvement of an ultra-high-vacuum cold-atom apparatus, including laser and optical systems, high-resolution imaging, and the control and data-acquisition software used to prepare, manipulate, and measure atomic quantum states.
  
  
This is a hands-on, full-cycle research role intended to prepare the candidate for a PhD program in experimental quantum physics. The Research Assistant will work closely with the faculty sponsor, postdoctoral scholars, and graduate students, taking ownership of well-defined subprojects spanning hardware (lasers, optics, electronics, vacuum) and software (experimental control, simulation, and data analysis). The position offers broad training in the experimental and computational methods underlying modern quantum technologies.  
  
**Job Duties**  

* Design, assemble, align, and maintain optical and laser systems (e.g., laser cooling/trapping beams, optical tweezers generated with acousto-optic deflectors/spatial light modulators, and high-resolution imaging optics).
* Operate and improve an ultra-high-vacuum neutral-atom apparatus, including assembly and troubleshooting of vacuum, optical, electronic, and RF/microwave subsystems.
* Develop, test, and document experimental control software, data-acquisition routines, and automated calibration sequences (primarily in Python).
* Perform numerical simulations and modeling of atomic and many-body systems to support experimental design and interpretation (e.g., lattice/tweezer trapping, single-particle and many-body dynamics).
* Collect, analyze, and visualize experimental data; apply statistical and computational methods to extract physical quantities and characterize system performance.
* Contribute to the design and fabrication of custom electronics, mechanical mounts, and printed-circuit boards as needed.
* Maintain detailed electronic lab notebooks and contribute to manuscripts, internal documentation, and group presentations.
* Follow all laboratory and laser-safety protocols and contribute to general upkeep of the laboratory.
* Occasionally lift and/or carry equipment weighing 25 pounds or more (e.g., optical components, breadboards, vacuum hardware, electronics racks).
* Occasional travel may be required to attend conferences, collaboration meetings, or training.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Physics, Engineering Physics, or a closely related field by the position start date.
* Coursework in atomic, molecular, and optical physics and/or quantum mechanics.
* Demonstrated research experience in experimental and/or computational physics.
* Programming proficiency in Python (or equivalent) for simulation, data analysis, and instrument control.
* Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and careful record-keeping.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team-based research environment. Ability to travel as needed for conferences and collaboration meetings.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Coursework or research experience in quantum simulation, quantum metrology, condensed matter, or many-body physics.
* Hands-on experience with laser-cooled atoms, optical lattices, ultracold atomic gases, or other AMO experimental platforms.
* Experience with optical alignment, lasers, vacuum systems, RF/microwave electronics, or FPGA-based control hardware.
* Experience with numerical methods and large-scale simulation.
* Intent to pursue a PhD in experimental AMO or quantum physics.

  
**Required Documents**  

* Resume.

  
  
  
**To be considered for this position please visit our web site and apply on line at the following link:** **https://hr.caltech.edu/work/job\_openings**  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

jobs.description:
Research Associate (9613C), Innovative Genomics Institute #89172 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Innovative Genomics Institute (IGI) is a partnership between the University of California, Berkeley and the University of California, San Francisco. The IGI envisions a world in which genome-engineering innovations benefit humanity and are accessible to all. The Institutes mission is to accelerate genome discovery and translation of resulting technologies in order to ethically and equitably improve human health and sustainable agriculture. Combining fundamental research expertise and biomedical talent, the IGI focuses on unraveling the mechanisms underlying CRISPR-based genome editing and applying this technology to cure disease, combat climate change, ensure food sustainability, and provide additional benefits for current and future generations.
  
  
**The IGI consists of four central programs:** Human Health, Sustainable Agriculture, Advancing Genome Engineering, and Public Impact. Unlike the first three, the Public Impact program does not involve laboratory research but instead focuses on accomplishing the goal of IGI founder, Jennifer Doudna, to ensure that genome engineering makes the world a better place.
  
  
To complement the laboratory work, the Public Impact Program places special emphasis on connecting the science of genome engineering to the world. The role of the Public Impact program is to engage in societal research, public and stakeholder engagement, outreach, and policy to align genome editing applications with societal needs and values, ensuring that benefits are ethical, accessible, and desirable.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Research Associate collaborates with a research team conducting molecular analysis of genome editing outcomes using droplet digital PCR (ddPCR) and other advanced assay-based techniques. This role involves the maintenance and expansion of sensitive mammalian cell lines, including iPSCs, and the execution of core molecular biology protocols to validate CRISPR-based therapeutic interventions. The Research Associate collaborates with a research team developing next-generation CRISPR-based therapeutics using various delivery techniques including, ribonucleoprotein (RNP) delivery approaches. Projects in the lab focus on engineering and delivering genome editing systems to treat diseases such as Huntington's disease, pediatric glioma, and sickle cell disease. Under supervision, the position assists with molecular biology techniques including cloning, protein and RNP preparation, cell culture, and genome editing assays, as well as evaluating delivery efficiency in relevant cell types. Supports laboratory operations, including preparing reagents, maintaining organized records, and assisting with experimental workflows. The role will contribute to research activities under a supervisor's guidance while supporting the lab's mission to develop accessible and effective genetic therapies.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is October 15, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Conducting ddPCR and dPCR assays to benchmark and evaluate gene editing efficiency, including the quantification of indels, excisions, and inversions.
  
Maintenance and characterization of mammalian cell cultures, with a specific focus on iPSCs and HSPCs.
  
General molecular biology tasks, including genomic DNA extraction, long-range PCR, and agarose gel electrophoresis.
  
Data management, interpretation of results, and reporting findings in team meetings.
  
General laboratory support, including the preparation of peptide solutions and equipment maintenance.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
Extensive experience with droplet digital PCR (ddPCR) and data interpretation.
  
Proficiency in mammalian cell culture techniques.
  
Standard molecular biology skills, including DNA extraction and PCR optimization.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
Experience writing and editing SOPs or quality reports.
  
Familiarity with and/or ability to learn CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing workflows and validation.
  
Strong data analysis skills using and/or ability to learn Microsoft Excel, R, or Python.
  
  
Education / Training
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Biochemistry, Bioengineering, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, or Genetics and/or equivalent training/experience. (Required)
  
  
Salary & Benefits
  
  
For information on the comprehensive benefits package offered by the University, please visit the University of California's Compensation & Benefits website.

jobs.description:
Prestige Consumer Healthcare is a company that focuses on product innovation and quality in the over-the-counter healthcare and women’s health categories to better improve the lives of our customers and their world. For generations, our trusted brands have helped consumers care for themselves and their loved ones. We are one of the largest independent providers of over-the-counter products in North America, and we are constantly improving and creating products that match the ever-changing lifestyles and needs of people and families everywhere.

JOB SUMMARY:

As a Senior Biomedical Engineer, you will work closely with cross-functional teams in our corporate headquarters in Tarrytown, NY focusing on new product development and R&D for the Breathe Right brand and supporting our other OTC medical device and device-adjacent portfolio spanning respiratory, oral care, eye care, women's health, dermatology, and digestive health brands. You will be a member of a cross-functional team to help take New Product Ideas from concept ideation through biomechanical validation, claims substantiation, and process qualification. Forging strong technical relationships with global 3rd party manufacturers will be critical to successfully develop and commercialize innovative medical devices. Your expertise in biomechanics, human factors engineering, and device performance will support evidence-based claims development and new product development for Class I and Class II medical devices.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITES/ACTIVTIES:
Serve as R&D technical lead for the Breathe Right brand and provide biomechanics and human factors expertise across Prestige's OTC medical device portfolio including oral care, eye care, women's health, dermatology, digestive health, and respiratory brands
Co-ideate new claims and indications with Marketing, providing scientific justification and validation strategies in collaboration with Regulatory and Legal teams
Develop validation and verification protocols including benchtop testing, wear studies, clinical endpoints, and objective measurement techniques (e.g., rhinometry, bite force analysis, ocular retention, adhesive performance) to support new claims and product launches
Participate in cross-functional teams from concept ideation through development, validation, and commercialization, acting as the technical authority in R&D for device performance, mechanism of action, and scientific substantiation
Define biomechanical performance requirements, human factors design criteria, and test methods for new and existing medical devices, ensuring alignment with regulatory standards for Class I and Class II devices
Collaborate with external partners, adhesive suppliers, converters, and manufacturers to evaluate adhesive technologies, define performance requirements, troubleshoot adhesion-related issues, and support material selection, scale-up, and commercialization for skin-contact and device-adjacent products
Monitor the competitive and technology landscape for emerging medical device platforms, novel materials, and adjacent product categories relevant to Prestige's OTC portfolio, translating insights into actionable innovation opportunities.

jobs.title: Sr Bioinformatics Scientist
jobs.description:
Senior Bioinformatics Scientist

Position Overview

Twist Bioscience is seeking a Senior Bioinformatics Scientist to join our Scientific Computing team supporting R&D across DNA Synthesis and Protein Solutions. You will develop computational methods and predictive models to understand biological and experimental data, guide product development, and improve scientific workflows.

Working at the intersection of computational and experimental biology, you will partner with scientists to investigate challenging questions across sequencing, DNA synthesis, and protein characterization. Your work will include developing algorithms, testing hypotheses, evaluating new methods, and building reproducible analysis workflows.

We are looking for a curious scientist with strong computational skills and sound scientific judgment who enjoys learning new biology and turning open-ended questions into actionable insights.

Key Responsibilities

Develop novel computational methods and algorithms supporting DNA synthesis, sequence analysis, and protein characterization.
Partner with experimental scientists to formulate hypotheses, design experiments, and interpret results that guide product and process development.
Analyze NGS and other experimental datasets to identify biological patterns, understand sources of variability, and investigate unexpected outcomes.
Apply statistical methods, machine learning, and predictive modeling to connect sequence and experimental features with product quality and performance.
Evaluate and validate analytical approaches, including their accuracy, limitations, and applicability across experimental conditions.
Develop reproducible analysis pipelines using Nextflow and other scientific computing tools to support research and method evaluation.
Communicate findings and recommendations to scientific and cross-functional stakeholders, and collaborate with engineers to translate successful methods into broader use.
Explore new technologies and analytical approaches as research priorities evolve.

Required Qualifications

Ph.D. with 3+ years, Master’s degree with 6+ years, or Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years of relevant experience in bioinformatics, computational biology, biostatistics, or a related field; equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered.
Strong Python programming skills and experience analyzing biological or experimental data.
Hands-on experience with NGS analysis and a solid understanding of molecular biology.
Experience developing and evaluating computational algorithms, statistical methods, or predictive models.
Strong foundation in statistics, experimental design, and critical interpretation of scientific results.
Experience building reproducible analysis workflows using Nextflow or a comparable tool.
Demonstrated ability to independently investigate scientific problems and learn unfamiliar methods or biological domains.
Ability to collaborate closely with experimental scientists and communicate complex findings clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with protein data analysis, DNA synthesis, or sequence design.
Experience applying machine learning to biological data, including rigorous validation.
Experience working with high-throughput experimental datasets and integrating multiple data types.
Familiarity with cloud computing and scalable scientific workflows.
A track record of developing computational methods that inform experimental decisions or improve products.

We welcome candidates with depth in a relevant scientific area and the curiosity and quantitative foundation to contribute across disciplines.

About Twist Bioscience

Twist Bioscience synthesizes genes from scratch, known as “writing” DNA. Just as children learn to both read and write, the next phase of development for the genomics revolution is the ability to write DNA.

At Twist Bioscience, we work in service of people who are changing the world for the better. In fields such as health care, agriculture, industrial chemicals and data storage, our unique silicon-based DNA Synthesis Platform provides precision at a scale that is otherwise unavailable to our customers.

Anaheim, CA - Retail shop

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces the unique perspectives of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders, and cultures across the world. We believe that a variety of backgrounds makes our team stronger and more innovative.

At Airgas, we RESPECT, HONOR and VALUE diversity.

Airgas is Hiring for an Automation Technician in Anaheim, CA!

We are looking for you!

Pay: $38.00 /hr - $44.00 /hr

Comprehensive Family Benefits: Airgas offers a full benefits package designed to support your whole life, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance.

Support for Parents: We offer up to 14-week paid child birth benefits to support growing families.

Future Security: 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match, Tuition Assistance, Paid Holidays, Vacation, and Sick time.

Early Access: Your benefits start after just 30 days of employment

The Automation Technician associate performs service work on plasma, oxy/fuel cutting systems, and robots. This position is also responsible for installation, preventative maintenance, onsite troubleshooting and service, and component repair. Performs component upgrades while ensuring a safe working environment.

Committed to safety and following company policies including the use of personal protective equipment.

Collaborates to troubleshoot cutting systems, components and robots.

Services components at customer sites on hard automation with mechanical and electrical issues.

Ideally brings a strong understanding of Welding Processes and Applications, Automation Motion devices, cutting systems, robotics software and controllers in order to collaboratively discuss and address issues, provide training, and navigate and solve complex technical challenges.

Helps maintain quality standards by testing, calibrating, and running machines according to manufacturer’s specifications.

Supports team clarity by completing service documentation in a timely and accurate manner.

Maintains a clean, organized and safe work environment by ensuring all health and safety guidelines are followed both at Airgas and customer facilities.

Responsible for attending two weeks of company paid training per year focused on advancing the technician's ability to serve our customer base.

Works closely with customers as a trusted partner to foster strong relationships and deliver shared success for the customer and RDA.

Maintains accurate and timely expense reporting.

________________________Are you a MATCH?

Must have minimum of three years of Advanced Automation service experience or two years of mechanical repair experience and completion of Airgas Automation Technician Apprenticeship program. Established track record or completion of the Airgas Apprenticeship program may possibly supersede educational requirements

Must have a broad knowledge of the welding, cutting and fabrication processes common to the Airgas customer base including but not limited to: Manual, semi-automated and automated welding processes.

Ability to read, write and interpret electrical schematics. Knowledge of welding and power equipment from many different suppliers.

Preferred Qualifications:

High School Diploma with Associate Degree Industrial Electronics/Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Technical School preferred.

Must be able to apply mathematical formulas that quantify the costs associated with the processes so analysis and comparisons may be created.

Ability to be a team player with positive attitude towards other associates, customers and work environment.

Must be self-motivated, success oriented, mechanically, technically and detail oriented.

Ability to be flexible and able to “shift gears” in the face of interrupted schedules, canceled appointments and unfulfilled promises.

Must be proficient with computer applications including but not limited to Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point, and Outlook.
